AI.motivation: 现有理论与唯象分析多假定强关联体系输运源于带反常自能的准粒子或流体集体激发，二者虽出发点不同，却共同预设电流耗散来自载流子总动量的弛豫。该经典图像在缺乏长寿命载流子时失效，此时耗散似由热平衡恢复速率支配，并被认为受"普朗克极限"上限约束，需要新的输运描述框架。
AI.method: 摒弃以弛豫率描述电导的框架，改以电流-电流关联函数（current-current correlation function）刻画奇异金属输运，结合快衰减电流涨落与量子细致平衡原理进行理论分析；并将该表示应用于铜氧化物超导体的实验光学数据，替代传统光电导分析。
AI.result: 奇异金属输运由快衰减的电流涨落承载，而非准粒子动量弛豫；与量子细致平衡结合可自然给出广泛观测到的普朗克耗散（Planckian dissipation）。对铜氧化物的分析表明，奇异金属响应在所有掺杂水平均存在，并在最佳掺杂之上出现第二个经典成分；该分析还揭示了与超导性、(赝)能隙相关的关键特征。
AI.conclusion: 以电流-电流关联函数替代光电导的分析方法简单而有力，使经典金属与量子金属的区分变得清晰，为金属性质提供新见解，并明确了理论理解上亟待突破的方向。

title: State-space symmetry in Boolean network ensembles
summary: Studies of evolving Boolean network systems have found that Boolean functions cluster into equivalence classes with a characteristic frequency distribution - a pattern governed by the Zyklenzeiger symmetry group - but the dynamical origin of this symmetry has remained unexplained. Here we show that it is a consequence of a fundamental symmetry of Boolean network dynamics itself. A Boolean network consists of nodes that update according to Boolean functions of their regulatory inputs; its global dynamics is encoded in a state-space network. We identify the dynamical symmetry group of ensembles of Boolean networks that average over random interaction topologies: for networks with $N$ nodes, it is the $N$-dimensional hyperoctahedral group, generated by node-flips and node-label permutations. These transformations are admissible for every Boolean network regardless of topology; for random-topology ensembles, including all ensembles of fixed in-degree $K<N$, they constitute the complete symmetry group. We also show that input-label permutations constitute a hidden gauge freedom of the dynamics. The Zyklenzeiger symmetry of Boolean functions follows directly from the node-flips of the hyperoctahedral group together with this gauge freedom. Boolean networks related by the hyperoctahedral group have isomorphic state-space networks and form its orbits, and Burnside's lemma gives the number of these orbits for any fixed network topology. It provides a symmetry reduction of the analysis of Boolean network dynamics and explains why the Boolean functions of evolved networks fall into Zyklenzeiger classes, and why these classes split in finite networks.

AI.tldr: 布尔网络动力学的状态空间网络具有超八面体群（节点翻转×节点置换）这一动力学对称群，它导出布尔函数的Zyklenzeiger等价类分布，并用Burnside引理给出轨道计数与对称性约化。
AI.motivation: 演化布尔网络研究发现布尔函数聚成具有特征频率分布的等价类，该分布由Zyklenzeiger对称群支配，但其动力学起源一直未获解释。
AI.method: 将布尔网络的全局动力学编码为状态空间网络；识别对随机交互拓扑取平均的系综的动力学对称群，论证其为N维超八面体群（由节点翻转与节点标签置换生成）；进一步指出输入标签置换构成隐藏规范自由度，并结合节点翻转推导Zyklenzeiger对称性；最后用Burnside引理计数对称轨道。
AI.result: 对任意拓扑、N节点网络，超八面体群变换均可行；对随机拓扑系综（包括所有固定入度K<N的系综）构成完整对称群。相关网络具有同构的状态空间网络并构成该群轨道，Burnside引理给出任意固定拓扑下的轨道数；Zyklenzeiger对称性由节点翻转与输入标签规范自由度共同导出。
AI.conclusion: Zyklenzeiger对称性是布尔网络动力学自身基本对称性的结果；该对称性为布尔网络动力学分析提供对称性约化，并解释了演化网络布尔函数落入Zyklenzeiger类以及这些类在有限网络中分裂的原因。

title: Field-Effect Magnon Transistor
summary: Antiferromagnetic magnons offer a promising platform for highspeed, energy-efficient information processing. Intrinsic odd-parity spin splitting in a cycloidal magnetic order offers a route to nonvanishing magnon transport in compensated magnets. Here, we propose a magnonic field-effect device (akin to a transistor) based on a ferroelectric antiferromagnet BiFeO3 in which a gate electric field reconfigures domain boundaries to amplify/modulate magnon transport. These boundaries switch the nonlocal inverse-spin-Hall response between low- and high-signal states, with a pronounced dependence on the direction of magnon propagation. Source-drain reversal, magnetic-field measurements, symmetry analysis, and first-principles calculations reveal nonreciprocal magnon transport associated with the reversal of spin angular momentum across the domain boundaries. Our results establish an electrically programmable, non-volatile magnon transistor.

AI.tldr: 基于铁电反铁磁体BiFeO3，利用栅极电场重构畴壁以放大/调制磁振子输运，实现电可编程的非易失磁振子晶体管。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁磁振子具备高速、低能耗信息处理的潜力，但补偿磁体中磁振子输运通常相互抵消。回旋型磁序中的本征奇宇称自旋劈裂为在补偿磁体中实现非零磁振子输运提供了途径，亟需可电控的功能器件。
AI.method: 提出类似晶体管的磁振子场效应器件：以铁电反铁磁体BiFeO3为介质，栅极电场重构畴壁；通过源漏反转、磁场测量、对称性分析与第一性原理计算，表征非局域逆自旋霍尔响应及磁振子传播方向依赖性。
AI.result: 畴壁使非局域逆自旋霍尔响应在低信号态与高信号态之间切换，并强烈依赖磁振子传播方向；源漏反转、磁场测量、对称性分析与第一性原理计算共同揭示，该非互易磁振子输运源于跨越畴壁的自旋角动量反转。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种电可编程、非易失的磁振子晶体管，展示了铁电反铁磁体中畴壁工程对磁振子输运的调控能力。

title: Compact Projected Pfaffian States for Rydberg-Blockaded Quantum Spin Systems
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. All codes and data used in this manuscript are available at https://github.com/ryuikaneko/vmc_pxp
summary: We numerically demonstrate that a compact projected Pfaffian ansatz effectively describes the ground state of the nonintegrable PXP model. The variational wave function is obtained by applying separate Gutzwiller and Rydberg-blockade projectors to a general fermionic paired state, and each blockade-allowed configuration has an amplitude given by the Pfaffian of a configuration-selected pairing matrix. The exact blockade-projected product state of a known frustration-free deformation of the PXP model lies within the variational manifold and provides a physically motivated initial state for the variational Monte Carlo optimization toward the ground state of the pure PXP model. For a one-dimensional system of $N$ sites, optimizing all symmetry-allowed pairings in an $O(N)$-parameter wave function yields a near-exact ground state with a normalized energy variance (V-score) of order $10^{-9}$ despite the exponentially large blockade-constrained Hilbert space. On the square lattice, an $O(N)$-parameter wave function with the same amplitude structure yields relative energy errors below $0.2\%$ for clusters accessible to exact diagonalization and produces magnetizations consistent with available benchmarks. These results show that the same projected Pfaffian construction can be applied to blockade-constrained systems in both one and two dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出并数值验证一种紧凑的投影Pfaffian拟设，可在O(N)参数下几乎精确描述PXP模型（1D）及方格晶格（2D）的阻挫受限基态。
AI.motivation: 非可积PXP模型基态位于指数大的Rydberg-blockade受限Hilbert空间中，缺乏紧凑、可控的变分描述；且缺乏对1D与2D统一适用的构造。
AI.method: 从一般费米子配对态出发，分别施加Gutzwiller投影与Rydberg-blockade投影，得到投影Pfaffian拟设：每个允许构型的振幅由按构型选取的配对矩阵的Pfaffian给出。以已知无阻挫形变PXP模型的精确blockade投影乘积态作为物理启发的初始态，用变分蒙特卡洛优化全部对称允许的配对参数（O(N)个），并在方格晶格上做相同振幅结构的变分计算，与精确对角化及已有基准比较。
AI.result: 1D N格点：优化全部对称允许配对后得到近精确基态，归一化能量方差（V-score）达10^-9量级，尽管受限Hilbert空间呈指数增长。2D方格晶格：相同振幅结构的O(N)参数波函数在可做精确对角化的团簇上给出相对能量误差低于0.2%，磁化与现有基准一致。
AI.conclusion: 同一投影Pfaffian构造可统一用于1D与2D的blockade受限系统，以极少参数高效、高精度地表征非可积受限模型基态。

title: Gate tunable spin splitting for Andreev spin qubits in Ge quantum well heterostructures
summary: Ge-based super-semi heterostructures are a promising platform for implementing Andreev spin qubits (ASQs). For example, they can be isotopically purified to eliminate nuclear spins that cause decoherence. However, spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which is a key ingredient for ASQs, is cubic in momentum for hole-based materials like Ge, in contrast with more-conventional ASQ materials (e.g., InAs wires), for which the SOC is linear in momentum. In this work, we study the interplay between geometrical properties like the channel width, and gate-tunable properties like the chemical potential, on ASQ operations. Intriguingly, we find that the spin splitting in a planar Ge Josephson junction does not depend on the junction width, in contrast with InAs nanowires. We explore the possibility of exploiting this property to suppress the harmful effects of charge traps. However, this prospect is spoiled by the fact that charge traps also affect the chemical potential, in addition to the channel width. Our results provide insights into the fundamental mechanisms governing spin splitting in ASQs and offer guidance for optimizing ASQs in other materials with cubic SOC.

AI.tldr: 研究平面Ge约瑟夫森结中立方自旋轨道耦合下沟道宽度与化学势对Andreev自旋量子比特操作的影响，发现自旋劈裂不依赖结宽（区别于InAs纳米线），并指出该特性因电荷陷阱同时影响化学势而难以用于抑制退相干。
AI.motivation: Ge基超导-半导体异质结可同位素纯化以消除核自旋退相干，是ASQ的有力平台；但其空穴体系SOC为动量三次方（立方），不同于InAs等常规材料的线性SOC，宽度、化学势等几何与栅控参数如何影响ASQ操作尚不清楚。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值计算平面Ge约瑟夫森结，考察沟道宽度等几何参数与栅控化学势对自旋劈裂及ASQ操作的联合影响，并与线性SOC的InAs纳米线对比。
AI.result: 平面Ge结中的自旋劈裂不随结宽变化，与InAs纳米线形成鲜明对比；据此评估了利用该无宽度依赖来抑制电荷陷阱有害效应的可能，但发现电荷陷阱同时改变化学势，从而使这一方案失效。
AI.conclusion: 立方SOC体系中自旋劈裂的宽度无关性源于其独特机制；仅靠几何设计无法屏蔽电荷陷阱影响。研究揭示了ASQ自旋劈裂的基本机制，并为优化其他立方SOC材料的ASQ提供指导。

title: Fragmentation in Non-Hermitian Many-Body Systems
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, accepted for publication in Phys. Rev.B, Supplemental document not included
summary: In non-Hermitian (NH) fermionic chains with spatially random imaginary gauge fields, single-particle eigenstates exhibit erratic NH skin localization with strongly fluctuating, subexponential decay, distinct from both conventional skin accumulation and Anderson localization. At finite filling, Pauli exclusion suppresses macroscopic accumulation and instead leads to fragmentation of the particle density, in sharp contrast to Hermitian disordered systems. Using exact free-fermion methods, we show that the density organizes into disconnected regions of high and low occupancy, forming spatially separated Fermi domains whose number $N_{\mathrm{FS}}$ scales subextensively with system size $L$. Remarkably, fragmentation is not only an equilibrium property but also emerges dynamically in the NH evolution, unlike in Hermitian systems where such structures are not dynamically selected. This behavior admits a Coulomb-gas description in a stochastic potential, establishing a direct link between erratic NH skin localization and real-space fragmentation of many-body states.

AI.tldr: 在具有空间随机虚规范场的非厄米费米链中，单粒子本征态呈现衰减剧烈涨落的亚指数型"不规则非厄米趋肤局域"；有限填充下泡利排斥导致粒子密度碎裂为空间分离的费米畴，且该碎裂在非厄米演化中动力学涌现，可用随机势下的库仑气体描述。
AI.motivation: 传统非厄米趋肤效应表现为宏观边界积累，安德森局域则是厄米无序体系的典型图像；随机虚规范场下的中间情形及其多体后果尚不清楚，尤其是有限填充下泡利排斥如何改变密度分布。
AI.method: 精确自由费米子方法，研究空间随机虚规范场的一维非厄米费米链；结合单粒子本征态分析、有限填充多体密度分布统计（费米畴数目 N_FS 随 L 的标度）以及非厄米时间演化，并引入随机势中的库仑气体映射。
AI.result: 1) 单粒子态呈现不规则趋肤局域，衰减为强涨落的亚指数形式，区别于常规趋肤积累与安德森局域；2) 有限填充下宏观积累被泡利排斥抑制，密度碎裂为高/低占据的不连通区域，形成空间分离的费米畴，其数目 N_FS 随系统尺寸 L 亚广延增长；3) 碎裂不仅存在于平衡态，也在非厄米动力学演化中自发出现，而厄米体系中此类结构不会被动力学选择。
AI.conclusion: 不规则非厄米趋肤局域与多体实空间碎裂之间存在直接联系，随机势库仑气体描述为二者提供了统一框架，并揭示了非厄米性可作为动力学筛选空间结构的机制。

title: Basic introduction to Freidlin-Wentzell theory
summary: Freidlin-Wentzell theory provides the quantitative foundation for rare, noise-induced transitions in stochastic dynamical systems, predicting optimal transition pathways, the exponential scaling of mean escape times, and the long-term occupancy of competing attractors in metastable systems. Here we present a pedagogical, physics-oriented review built around a unified Hamiltonian framework: starting from the infinitesimal generator of a continuous-time Markov process, we derive the local Hamiltonian, obtain the Lagrangian and action functional via Legendre-Fenchel duality, and construct the quasi-potential landscape. We apply this streamlined formalism across weak-noise diffusions, Markov jump processes, weakly interacting particle ensembles, and nonequilibrium stochastic fields, alongside exact conditions for macroscopic coarse-graining. Along the way, we highlight how broken detailed balance drives forward and reverse transition paths apart, explain where local linear stability and Gaussian approximations break down, and assemble multi-attractor landscapes using combinatorial $W$-graphs. Finally, we bridge the analytical theory to modern numerical solvers, including ordered upwind methods, geometric minimum action algorithms, and neural-network parameterizations, and provide an accompanying GPU-accelerated Python package.

AI.tldr: 一篇以统一Hamiltonian框架讲授Freidlin-Wentzell稀有跃迁理论的综述，涵盖弱噪声扩散、马尔可夫跳跃过程、弱相互作用粒子系综与非平衡随机场，并衔接数值算法与GPU加速Python包。
AI.motivation: Freidlin-Wentzell理论是稀有噪声诱导跃迁的定量基础，但相关方法分散于扩散、跳跃过程、粒子系统与非平衡场等不同文献，缺乏统一、面向物理学的教学性梳理，且解析理论与现代数值求解器之间缺少衔接。
AI.method: 从连续时间马尔可夫过程的无穷小生成元出发，构造局部Hamiltonian，经Legendre-Fenchel对偶得到Lagrangian与作用量泛函，并构建准势能景观；在该统一形式下处理弱噪声扩散、马尔可夫跳跃过程、弱相互作用粒子系综与非平衡随机场，并给出宏观粗粒化的精确条件；用组合W-图组装多吸引子景观。
AI.result: 说明破缺的细致平衡如何使正向与反向跃迁路径分离，指出局部线性稳定性与高斯近似失效的情形，并将解析理论与有序迎风方法、几何最小作用量算法及神经网络参数化等数值求解器对接。
AI.conclusion: Hamiltonian作用量框架可作为统一语言贯通稀有事件理论的分析与计算，并配套发布GPU加速的Python软件包以支持实际应用。

title: Quadrupole Origin of the Orbital Hall Effect in an $sp^3$ Centrosymmetric Lattice: Robustness and Tunability under Disorder
summary: We investigate how disorder affects orbital Hall transport in the centrosymmetric spinless $sp^3$ tight-binding model on a square lattice, widely used as a minimal model for the orbital Hall effect [1]. In the pristine system, the intrinsic orbital Hall response is related to the quadrupolar orbital texture generated by $s$-$p$ hybridization. Using the Kubo-Bastin formalism expanded in Chebyshev polynomials, we analyze the effect of vacancies, orbital-dependent Anderson on-site disorder, and selective $V_{spσ}$-bond disorder on the orbital transport. For Anderson disorder and vacancies, the longitudinal charge conductivity decreases faster than the orbital Hall conductivity over the range studied, leading to an increase of the orbital Hall angle and, in the Anderson case, saturation at stronger disorder. Selective $V_{spσ}$-bond disorder behaves differently: by modifying only the $s$-$p$ hybridization channel while leaving the remaining hopping network intact, it can produce a non-monotonic orbital Hall response and enhance the orbital Hall conductivity at intermediate dilution. Overall, our results show that the orbital Hall response remains sizable under vacancy and on-site disorder, while selective modification of the $s$-$p$ hybridization provides an additional route to tune the orbital Hall conductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文用Chebyshev展开的Kubo-Bastin方法，研究空位、轨道依赖Anderson无序及选择性V_{spσ}键无序对中心对称无自旋sp^3紧束缚模型轨道霍尔输运的影响。
AI.motivation: sp^3紧束缚模型是研究轨道霍尔效应的极简模型，但无序如何影响其轨道霍尔输运尚缺乏系统认识，尤其不同无序类型（空位、在位、键无序）的差异化作用有待厘清。
AI.method: 在方格子上构建中心对称、无自旋的sp^3紧束缚模型；干净体系中内禀轨道霍尔响应源于s-p杂化产生的四极轨道织构。采用Chebyshev多项式展开的Kubo-Bastin形式，计算纵向电荷电导、轨道霍尔电导与轨道霍尔角，分别考察空位、轨道依赖Anderson在位无序和选择性V_{spσ}键无序。
AI.result: 对Anderson无序与空位，纵向电荷电导下降快于轨道霍尔电导，轨道霍尔角增大；Anderson情形在强无序下趋于饱和。选择性V_{spσ}键无序仅改变s-p杂化通道而保留其余跃迁网络，可产生非单调轨道霍尔响应，并在中等稀释度下增强轨道霍尔电导。
AI.conclusion: 空位与在位无序下轨道霍尔响应仍保持可观量级；选择性调控s-p杂化为调节轨道霍尔电导提供了额外途径。

title: Double quantum dots as dynamical impurities in one-dimensional transport
summary: We study single-electron scattering in a tight-binding chain capacitively coupled to double quantum dots, which act as dynamical two-level-system impurities with electrically tunable level splittings. For a single impurity, we solve the scattering problem exactly and show Feshbach-like perfect elastic reflection, whose resonant condition distinguishes the initial two-level state. For several impurities in a strongly reflecting chain, transmission peaks at an intermediate mean level splitting. At small splittings, energy exchange with the impurities can weaken constructive interference between backscattered paths, consistent with the initial rise in transmission. As excitation channels close, virtual transitions can enhance reflection and drive transmission below its purely elastic value $T_0$. At larger splittings, these virtual processes weaken and transmission approaches $T_0$. We discuss how gate-controlled transmission measurements in quantum-dot arrays could test these predictions.

AI.tldr: 研究紧束缚链与双量子点（可调谐二能级杂质）耦合下的单电子散射，给出单杂质精确解与Feshbach型完美弹性反射条件，并分析多杂质情形下能级劈裂相关的透射峰与非弹性效应。
AI.motivation: 将双量子点作为电学可调的二能级系统杂质引入紧束缚链，探究动态杂质对相干输运的影响，并提供量子点阵列门控透射测量可检验的预言。
AI.method: 单杂质情形下精确求解散射问题；对强反射链中的多个杂质，分析平均能级劈裂、能量交换（非弹性通道）与虚跃迁对透射的影响。
AI.result: 单杂质出现类似Feshbach的完美弹性反射，共振条件可区分初始二能级态；多杂质时透射在中等平均劈裂处出现峰值；小劈裂下能量交换削弱背散射路径间的相消/相长干涉，对应透射的初始上升；激发通道关闭后虚跃迁增强反射，使透射低于纯弹性值T0；大劈裂时虚过程减弱，透射趋近T0。
AI.conclusion: 动态二能级杂质通过弹性共振与非弹性/虚过程共同调控单电子透射，量子点阵列中的门控输运测量可用于检验这些预言。

title: Spectral Moments of the Projected Hubbard Configuration Graph: Connectivity, Exchange, and Virtual Doublons
comment: 42 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables; Supplemental Material (notes S1-S12, 142 pages) as ancillary file. Code, Lean 4 formalization and run records: https://github.com/zhineos/hubbard-spectral-moments, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24244237
summary: At strong on-site repulsion, the lowest band of $n$ lattice fermions is the spectrum of the hopping projected onto configurations without double occupancy, $H_\infty=P_0H_tP_0$. We study its moments, for few fermions in the square-lattice Hubbard model and, where the arguments allow, on any finite graph. (1) For spin-independent Hermitian hopping (no on-site terms) on any $N\geq2$-site graph, $μ_2=\frac{n(N-n)}{N(N-1)}\sum_{i\neq j}|t_{ij}|^2$, for any spin composition. (2) On any finite graph, $μ_4$ is exactly linear in the same-spin pair count, as four hops permute particles by at most a transposition or 3-cycle; for uniform hopping on a simple graph with $N\geq4$ the slope is $α(N,n)=-8C_4(N-n)(8N-11n-2)/[N(N-1)(N-2)(N-3)]$, fixed by the number $C_4$ of 4-cycles. (3) At large finite $U$, the second-order Schrieffer-Wolff correction is Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonal to $H_\infty$ on every triangle-free graph, so the band variance has no $1/U$ term; its $U^{-2}$ coefficient, an exact trace checked by exact diagonalization, is negative at the low fillings computed. (4) Under a Peierls flux, the exchange slope $α(N,2,Φ)=-\frac{64}{N-1}\cosΦ_\square$ ($L\times L$ tori, $L=3$ or $L\geq5$) carries the ordinary charge-$e$ harmonic, while the doublon (bound-pair) hopping acquires a doubled phase, $t_de^{2iA_{ij}}$: the second-order single-doublon Hamiltonian is exactly $π$-periodic ($h/2e$) under a boundary twist, and the exact two-electron U-band follows numerically, up to $O((2λ)^L/U^{L-1})$. Result (1), the permutation bound, the orthogonality in (3) and the doubled phase are machine-checked in Lean 4. Repulsive binding and the pair charge $2e$ are known; new are the exact moment structure and the derivation of the doubled phase. We make no claim about many-pair phase stiffness, off-diagonal long-range order or superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 研究强在位排斥下投影动能 $H_\infty=P_0H_tP_0$ 的矩结构，给出二阶矩、四阶矩的精确解析式，证明二阶 Schrieffer-Wolff 修正与 $H_\infty$ 正交，并证明双空位（doublon）跳跃获得加倍相位，从而单-doublon 哈密顿量呈 $\pi$ 周期。
AI.motivation: 强 $U$ 极限下最低 Hubbard 带即投影跳跃谱，但其矩结构（尤其四阶矩与自旋/填充/环数的关系）及其在磁通下的响应缺乏精确刻画；同时希望厘清二阶有效理论中单占与双占通道的正交性与相位性质。
AI.method: 对少费米子（任意有限图、任意自旋组分）解析计算 $\mu_2,\mu_4$ 的迹；利用四步跳跃至多产生对换或 3-循环的置换论证将 $\mu_4$ 线性化于同自旋对计数；用 Schrieffer-Wolff 变换在无三角图上讨论 Hilbert-Schmidt 正交性；在 Peierls 通量下追踪相位（普通电荷 $e$ 谐波 vs. doublon 的双倍相位 $e^{2iA}$），并以精确对角化与 Lean 4 机器验证。
AI.result: (1) $\mu_2=\frac{n(N-n)}{N(N-1)}\sum_{i\neq j}|t_{ij}|^2$;(2) $\mu_4$ 精确线性于同自旋对数，简单图均匀跳跃斜率 $\alpha(N,n)=-8C_4(N-n)(8N-11n-2)/[N(N-1)(N-2)(N-3)]$;(3) $1/U$ 项消失，$U^{-2}$ 系数为负；(4) $\alpha(N,2,\Phi)=-\frac{64}{N-1}\cos\Phi_\square$，单-doublon 哈密顿量严格 $\pi$ 周期，双电子 U 带数值吻合至 $O((2\lambda)^L/U^{L-1})$。
AI.conclusion: 给出投影动能各阶矩的精确、普适结构，并首次导出 doublon 跳跃的双倍相位（$h/2e$ 周期）；作者明确不对多对相刚度、非对角长程序或超导性作任何断言。

title: Certifying quantum generative models beyond the Fisher trace
summary: Whether a trained quantum generative model has learned its target is usually decided by a diagnostic validated on a labeled benchmark, and such a diagnostic can pass that validation by recovering how the benchmark was built. We analyze Fisher-trace and kernel-based certification of the real-amplitude quantum circuit Born machine in noiseless statevector simulation. For real-amplitude circuits built from half-angle rotations, the classical Fisher information equals the quantum Fisher information almost everywhere, so its trace equals the parameter count and carries no information about fit quality. The Fisher eigenvalue rank counts the live nodes of the amplitude tree: it coincides with the label on a sparse benchmark and is uninformative on a full-support one. The pooled Wasserstein and maximum-mean-discrepancy scores move with optimizer convergence and with the scoring convention. For two bitstring defect families on which both metrics have closed forms, we compute the tolerance-mismatch window in which the discrepancy rejects generators that the transport threshold admits; it opens only at certification-grade tolerances and closes as the qubit number grows. On the Hamming cost we prove a sharp tolerance ratio above which the discrepancy vote is redundant, and we obtain the exact worst-parity minimax value over all unit-diagonal positive-semidefinite kernels, which is exponentially small in the qubit number. In a numerical campaign at the tolerances a near-term experiment can resolve, the discrepancy vote changed no verdict at a thousand shots or more. The false-pass guarantee does not extend to device noise.

AI.tldr: 该文分析实振幅量子电路Born机的Fisher迹与核方法认证诊断，指出这些诊断在稀疏/特定基准上会通过"复原基准构造方式"而失效，并在近期待解分辨率下核投票几乎不改变判定结论。
AI.motivation: 量子生成模型的训练质量通常由在带标签基准上验证过的诊断指标来判定，但这类诊断可通过"恢复基准的构造方式"而非真正的拟合质量来通过验证，因此需要检验Fisher迹与核方法认证在实振幅量子电路Born机上究竟携带多少关于拟合质量的信息。
AI.method: 在无噪声态矢量模拟下研究实振幅量子电路Born机：1) 对半角旋转构造的实振幅电路比较经典与量子Fisher信息及其迹；2) 分析Fisher特征值秩与振幅树活结点数的关系；3) 研究池化Wasserstein距离与MMD分数随优化器收敛及评分约定的变化；4) 在两个具有闭式解的双比特串缺陷族上计算容差失配窗口；5) 在Hamming代价下证明尖锐容差比及所有单位对角半正定核上的最坏奇偶极小极大值；6) 开展数值实验。
AI.result: 实振幅半角旋转电路中经典Fisher信息几乎处处等于量子Fisher信息，其迹等于参数个数，不含拟合质量信息；Fisher特征值秩等于振幅树活结点数，在稀疏基准上恰等于标签，在全支撑基准上无信息量。池化Wasserstein与MMD分数随优化器收敛和评分约定变化。容差失配窗口仅在认证级容差下打开，并随量子比特数增加而关闭。Hamming代价下得到尖锐容差比，超过后核投票冗余；所有单位对角半正定核上的最坏奇偶极小极大值随量子比特数指数小。数值实验中在近期待实验可分辨的容差下，千次采样以上的核投票未改变任何判定。
AI.conclusion: 该类Fisher迹与核方法认证诊断在实振幅量子电路Born机上大多不携带拟合质量信息，其"通过"可能源于基准构造的泄漏；核投票在可实现的容差与采样规模下冗余。此外，误通过保证不能推广到含噪器件。

title: Chiral Majorana Charge Kondo Criticality
summary: Unambiguous identification of chiral Majorana edge modes remains challenging because the transport signatures proposed for them can also arise from conventional mechanisms. Here we identify the chiral Majorana charge Kondo (CMCK) critical point as a more discriminating many-body route to detect chiral Majorana edge modes. This criticality arises in a charged island hosting a single chiral Majorana edge mode, where Majorana self-conjugacy locks normal and anomalous tunneling amplitudes, so that each physical lead provides two Kondo screening channels without fine tuning. Ordinary subgap states generically break this locking and drive the system toward conventional charge Kondo (CK) behavior. In the simplest two-terminal geometry, CMCK and conventional CK share the critical conductance $G^*=e^2/2h$, but their leading conductance corrections scale as $T^{1/3}$ and $T$, respectively. Their residual entropies also differ, as do the crossover exponents under gate detuning and contact asymmetry. For $N$ leads, CMCK conductance corrections scale as $T^{1/(N+1)}$, and for $N\geq3$ even the critical conductance differs from that of conventional CK with the same number of leads. These universal signatures are testable using established charge-Kondo measurement techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出手性马约拉纳电荷近藤（CMCK）临界点作为识别手性马约拉纳边缘模式的多体判据，其与常规电荷近藤（CK）在电导修正幂律、残余熵和交叠指数上存在可区分的普适差异。
AI.motivation: 已有手性马约拉纳边缘模式的输运特征（如量子化电导）也可由常规机制产生，缺乏无歧义的鉴别手段，因此需要一个更具判别力的探测途径。
AI.method: 考虑承载单一手性马约拉纳边缘模式的带电岛：马约拉纳自共轭性锁定了正常与反常隧穿振幅，使每个物理引线无需精细调节即提供两个近藤屏蔽通道，从而形成CMCK临界性；普通亚带隙态会破坏该锁定并驱向常规CK。通过分析两终端与N终端几何下的电导临界值、领头修正幂律、残余熵及栅压失谐与接触不对称下的交叠指数进行区分。
AI.result: 两终端下CMCK与常规CK临界电导同为G*=e²/2h，但领头电导修正分别按T^{1/3}与T标度；残余熵及交叠指数亦不同。N引线时CMCK修正按T^{1/(N+1)}标度，且N≥3时临界电导本身即与同引线数的常规CK不同。
AI.conclusion: CMCK临界点提供了一套可区分手性马约拉纳边缘模式与常规亚带隙态的普适输运指纹，并可用现有电荷近藤测量技术检验。

title: Calculating correlation functions in integrable spin chains from local conserved charges and currents
summary: We develop a simple algebraic method for calculating correlation functions in integrable spin chains. We introduce current minors, antisymmetrized products of local conserved charge densities and their currents, and prove that their expectation values are determinants of density and current mean values. Decomposing local operators into current minors, we derive factorized formulas for correlation functions in terms of current mean values, valid in any nondegenerate eigenstate. Applying the method to the spin-$1/2$ XXZ chain and, more generally, to every representation of the Temperley--Lieb algebra, we prove previously conjectured factorized formulas for short-distance correlation functions.

AI.tldr: 提出“流子式”代数方法计算可积自旋链关联函数：其期望值为密度与流均值的行列式，将局域算子按流子式展开即得任意非简并本征态下因子化关联函数公式，并在XXZ链及Temperley–Lieb代数的所有表示中证明了此前猜测的短程关联因子化公式。
AI.motivation: 可积自旋链中的关联函数计算长期依赖复杂的代数Bethe Ansatz与多重积分，短程关联的因子化结构此前仅以猜想形式存在，缺乏统一般的代数证明框架。
AI.method: 引入“流子式”（current minors）——局域守恒荷密度及其流的反对称化乘积，证明其期望值等于密度与流均值构成的行列式；再把一般局域算子分解为流子式的线性组合，从而将关联函数因子化为流均值的乘积形式；随后将框架应用于自旋1/2 XXZ链及Temperley–Lieb代数的任意表示。
AI.result: 得到对任意非简并本征态均成立的因子化关联函数公式；对XXZ链及所有Temperley–Lieb代数表示，严格证明了此前被猜想的短程关联因子化公式。
AI.conclusion: 关联函数的因子化根源于守恒荷的代数结构，可用行列式与算子分解以纯代数方式导出；该方法统一并推广了短程关联结果，为更一般的可积模型关联函数计算提供了简洁工具。

title: Ferroelectric control of the $K$--$Γ$ valley landscape in R-stacked bilayer WSe$_2$
summary: In bilayer WSe2 the valence-band maxima at K and Γ lie within a few thermal energies of one another, and gating redistributes holes between a light and a heavy valley of different mobilities on a landscape that stays fixed. We show that rhombohedral (R) stacking moves the landscape itself. The three-fold symmetry of R stacking forbids interlayer tunneling at K but not at Γ. The K coupling is therefore exactly zero, not merely small. A fit that leaves the coupling free returns an upper bound of 0.017 meV, three orders of magnitude under k_BT at room temperature, while the Γ coupling is 361.8 meV. The polarization creates a potential step between the layers and splits the K doublet. Each K state stays on a single layer, so the K edge shifts by half of that splitting, 41.7 meV, which any tunneling would reduce. Γ barely responds. Two consequences follow from symmetry alone, whatever the size of that shift. The two registries, carrying opposite out-of-plane ferroelectric polarizations, are exact mirror images along the displacement-field axis, and reversing the polarization reverses the displacement of the landscape. Their differential-mode transconductances are equal and opposite at zero field, where the response vanishes for an ideal nonpolar reference. The stored polarization is read out as a reversal of sign and not as a difference of current. Sweeping the field is a second route to the same parity. In the ideal symmetric limit the transconductance passes through zero at the field that cancels the polarization, 1.07 V/nm, at a single temperature. Both routes are limited by the symmetry of the device more than by the band structure. Stacking also renormalizes the landscape, so the polar one is not a translated copy of the nonpolar reference. Absolute offsets follow the exchange-correlation functional. The symmetry relations do not.

AI.tldr: 双层WSe2中R堆垛的三重对称性使K谷层间耦合严格为零，从而使其成为研究偏振读出与能谷输运对称性约束的理想平台。
AI.motivation: 双层WSe2中K与Γ价带顶能量接近，栅压只能在同一固定能谷"地形"上重新分配空穴，而无法改变地形本身；作者希望找到一种能直接移动能谷对齐格局的机制，并厘清层间耦合与铁电极化对能谷结构的真实作用，从而使存储的极化能够以符号反转而非电流差的形式被读出。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理（不同交换关联泛函）对比R堆垛与理想非极性参考体系，将层间耦合作为自由参数拟合以给出K谷耦合的上界；结合对称性论证：R堆垛的三重对称性禁止K谷层间隧穿但允许Γ谷耦合；分析极化在层间造成的势阶对K双重态的劈裂（K态定域于单层，故K边移动为劈裂之半）；并讨论两种位移场扫场路径下的差分模式跨导奇偶性。
AI.result: 拟合得到的K谷层间耦合上界为0.017 meV，比室温k_BT低三个数量级，而Γ谷耦合为361.8 meV；K边因势阶劈裂移动41.7 meV，Γ几乎不响应。两种具有相反面外铁电极化的堆垛构型沿位移场轴严格互为镜像，零场处差分模式跨导等大反号；在理想对称极限下，跨导在抵消极化（1.07 V/nm）处于单一温度穿过零点。堆垛还会重整化能谷地形，使极性体系并非非极性参考的平移拷贝；绝对偏移依赖交换关联泛函，但对称性关系不依赖。
AI.conclusion: K谷耦合的严格零值源自对称性而非数值偶然，由此产生的两个推论仅由对称性决定，与劈裂大小无关；因此极化的读出与扫场判据主要受器件对称性限制而非能带结构，R堆垛双层WSe2可作为由对称性保护的铁电-能谷耦合原型。

title: Mixed-state topological transitions with hidden long-range correlations
summary: We study a decoherence-driven transition from a one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological state to a trivial product state. The decoherence acts onsite while preserving the protecting symmetry on average. Although conventional local correlations remain short-ranged across the transition, we uncover hidden nondecaying long-range correlations in a symmetry-twisted ensemble that weights states according to their symmetry charge. At the transition, the twisted correlation length diverges and the twisted partition function becomes singular. These signatures can be directly extracted from symmetry-resolved measurement outcomes, making the hidden critical behavior accessible on current quantum platforms at mesoscopic system sizes. We demonstrate this through numerical simulations of the measurement process.

AI.tldr: 研究在保持保护对称性（平均意义下）的在位退相干驱动下，一维对称保护拓扑态向平庸乘积态的转变：常规局域关联始终短程，但在按对称荷加权的"对称扭转"系综中揭示出隐藏的非衰减长程关联，扭转关联长度在转变点发散、扭转配分函数出现奇异性，并可由对称分辨测量结果直接提取。
AI.motivation: 在平均保持保护对称性的在位退相干下，SPT 态到平庸态的转变在常规局域观测量中看不出临界性，需要寻找能刻画该隐藏相变的新序参量/诊断量，并使其在当前量子平台上可测量。
AI.method: 考虑一维 SPT 态在保持对称性的在位退相干通道下的动力学/稳态演化；引入按对称荷（对称电荷）加权的"对称扭转"系综，计算该系综内的二点关联函数与扭转配分函数，并用测量过程的数值模拟（对称分辨测量采样）验证其对临界行为的敏感性。
AI.result: 普通局域关联在整个转变过程中保持短程；扭转系综中出现不衰减的隐藏长程关联，扭转关联长度在转变点发散，扭转配分函数呈奇异行为；这些信号可从对称分辨的测量数据中提取，且数值模拟表明在介观尺度（有限系统）下即可观测。
AI.conclusion: 对称性保护的退相干相变可表现为"隐藏"的临界性，只能通过对称荷分辨/扭转系综的诊断量揭示；该方案提供了在现有量子模拟平台上以介观规模直接探测退相干诱导 SPT 相变的可操作途径。

title: Hidden Momenta due to Magneto-Electric Coupling in Non-Reciprocal Media
summary: From a canonical quantisation approach of macroscopic quantum electrodynamics, we derive the interaction Hamiltonian due to a dipole emitter interacting with a time-symmetry-broken topological insulator (TSB-TI), described by an axionic coupling Lagrangian. This provides an additional interaction term dependent on the magneto-electric coupling strength inherent to the TSB-TI which will modify measurements on related observables. The spontaneous decay rate is calculated in the Born-Markov approximation for a general electromagnetic Green's tensor, and then specifically for the case of a planar parallel-plate cavity.

AI.tldr: 从宏观量子电动力学的正则量子化出发，导出偶极发射体与时间反演对称性破缺拓扑绝缘体（TSB-TI）的相互作用哈密顿量，给出含磁电耦合强度的额外相互作用项，并在Born-Markov近似下计算自发辐射衰减率。
AI.motivation: TSB-TI的轴子型耦合会在偶极发射体与电磁场相互作用中引入常规介质所没有的额外项，从而修正相关可观测量的测量结果，需要从第一性原理给出其量子化描述。
AI.method: 以宏观QED正则量子化为框架，用轴子耦合拉格朗日量描述TSB-TI，导出偶极-场相互作用哈密顿量；在Born-Markov近似下，对一般电磁Green张量计算自发辐射衰减率，并将其具体化到平板平行板腔情形。
AI.result: 得到依赖TSB-TI本征磁电耦合强度的附加相互作用项，以及以Green张量表示的一般自发衰减率公式，并给出平板腔中的具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 轴子型磁电耦合会显著改变偶极发射体的自发辐射特性，Green张量方法可统一处理一般几何；平行板腔为实验检验该效应提供了可行构型。

title: Charge-Transfer Energy Governed by $f$-$d$ Coulomb Interaction in Rare-Earth Systems
summary: The $f$-$d$ Coulomb interaction ($U_{\rm fd}$) plays a central role in low-energy theories describing valence fluctuations and quantum valence criticality in rare-earth systems. In contrast, core-level spectroscopies have conventionally been analyzed using the phenomenological charge-transfer energy ($Δ$), and the relationship between these two descriptions has remained unclear. Here, we develop a spectroscopic framework demonstrating that the charge-transfer energy contains an $f$-$d$ Coulomb contribution $U_{\rm fd}n_d$ arising from the $d$-electron occupation ($n_d$), leading to the charge-transfer energy $Δ'$. We apply this framework to the prototypical valence-transition compound YbInCu$_4$ and demonstrate, from combined analyses of core-level photoemission and $L$-edge x-ray absorption spectroscopy, that the observed spectroscopic evolution across the first-order valence transition is consistently interpreted in terms of the variation of $Δ'$.

AI.tldr: 本文建立谱学框架，证明电荷转移能Δ包含来自d电子占据的f-d库仑贡献U_fd·n_d，从而得到Δ'，并用该框架统一解释了YbInCu4一级价态转变前后的芯能级谱演化。
AI.motivation: f-d库仑相互作用U_fd在描述稀土体系价涨落与量子价态临界性的低能理论中居核心地位，而芯能级谱学传统上却用唯象的电荷转移能Δ来分析，二者关系长期不明。
AI.method: 提出解析性的谱学框架，将电荷转移能分解为唯象部分与f-d库仑项U_fd·n_d，导出修正的电荷转移能Δ'；并以典型价态转变化合物YbInCu4为对象，联合分析芯能级光电子谱与L边X射线吸收谱。
AI.result: 在YbInCu4中，一级价态转变前后观测到的谱学演化可被Δ'的变化一致地解释，表明该演化主要源于d电子占据改变引起的U_fd·n_d项变化。
AI.conclusion: 电荷转移能Δ并非纯唯象参数，而内禀包含f-d库仑贡献；Δ'为连接低能U_fd理论与芯能级谱学提供了统一描述，可用于定量解读稀土价态转变体系的谱学行为。

title: A feedback-driven central limit theorem with $q$-Gaussian limits
summary: We establish a central limit theorem, the feedback-driven central limit theorem, for sums whose summands are independent noise variables multiplied by an amplitude that depends on the preceding normalized sum $y$. The summands are martingale differences whose conditional variance, $c+b\,y^{2}$, depends quadratically on $y$, with feedback strength $b$; unlike in the martingale central limit theorem, this conditional variance does not settle to a constant. The noise has finite variance; for positive feedback we assume, as in Lyapunov's theorem, a finite third moment, and for negative feedback bounded noise, so that the conditional variance stays nonnegative. For positive feedback, the normalized sum converges to a Student law, equivalently a $q$-Gaussian with $1<q<2$, independently of the noise distribution. For negative feedback, it converges to a compactly supported density, which is a $q$-Gaussian with $q<1$ when $-\tfrac12<b<0$. The Gaussian law, $q=1$, is recovered at zero feedback, while the Cauchy law, $q=2$, is obtained only as a limiting case, in a triangular array in which the feedback grows slowly with the number of terms. Thus every $q<2$ is obtained for a fixed feedback strength, and $q=2$ as a limit. We further show that the balance identity behind the theorem singles out quadratic feedback: a $q$-Gaussian with $q<2$ satisfies it only for a quadratic conditional variance, and no $q$-Gaussian with $2\le q<3$ satisfies it for any conditional variance. The proofs use the method of moments for negative feedback and a Wasserstein coupling argument for positive feedback, including cases in which the limiting variance is infinite.

AI.tldr: 该文建立"反馈驱动的中心极限定理"：当独立噪声乘以前一项归一化和y的振幅、条件方差为c+by²时，正反馈下和收敛到q∈(1,2)的q-高斯（Student律），负反馈下收敛到紧支撑分布，零反馈回到高斯、Cauchy律仅作极限出现；且平衡恒等式唯一确定二次型反馈。
AI.motivation: 经典鞅中心极限定理要求条件方差收敛到常数，无法处理条件方差随状态y变化、不趋于常数的情形；作者希望刻画"反馈"（条件方差含y²项）对归一化和极限分布的影响，并解释q-高斯/Student律在固定反馈强度下的出现机制。
AI.method: 考虑独立噪声变量乘以前一项归一化和y的函数后的鞅差序列，条件方差设为c+by²（反馈强度b）。正反馈情形假设噪声有限三阶矩（类Lyapunov条件），负反馈情形假设噪声有界以保证方差非负；负反馈用矩方法，正反馈用Wasserstein耦合论证，且覆盖极限方差无穷的情形。
AI.result: 正反馈下归一化和依分布收敛到Student律，即1<q<2的q-高斯，且与噪声分布无关；负反馈下收敛到紧支撑密度，当-1/2<b<0时为q<1的q-高斯；b=0回到高斯（q=1）；Cauchy（q=2）仅在反馈随项数缓慢增长的三角阵列极限中出现。此外，定理背后的平衡恒等式唯一定出二次型条件方差：q<2的q-高斯只对二次型条件方差满足该恒等式，而2≤q<3的任何q-高斯对任何条件方差都不满足。
AI.conclusion: 反馈强度b作为固定参数即可实现任意q<2的q-高斯极限（q=2为极限情形），极限分布由反馈符号与强度决定而与噪声细节无关；平衡恒等式揭示了二次型反馈的特殊性，为q-高斯的生成提供了机制性解释。

title: State Diagram of Dual-Free-Layer Perpendicular Magnetic Tunnel Junctions for Artificial Spiking Neurons
summary: The performance of perpendicular magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) depends critically on interfacial properties and layer thicknesses, small variations of which can substantially modify their magnetic and transport characteristics. This work investigates, experimentally and numerically, a perpendicular MTJ with two free layers, a configuration that preserves the precessional dynamics of the device while simplifying its fabrication. Quasi-static state diagrams measured under magnetic fields and DC or pulsed bias reveal static parallel, antiparallel, and bistable regimes, as well as a dynamical windmill regime in which the reversal of one layer triggers that of the other, giving rise to spiking neuron-like signals. Macrospin simulations reproduce these diagrams, and a stability analysis of the Landau-Lifchitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation yields an analytical description of the critical lines, including the windmill threshold voltage. The comparison also reveals a quadratic term in the voltage dependence of the spin-transfer torque that Joule heating cannot explain. The analytical model shows that the threshold voltage can be lowered either by approaching the spin-reorientation transition, at the cost of thermal stability, or by enhancing the quadratic contribution to the spin-transfer torque. These results establish guidelines for optimizing multilayer MTJ stacks for artificial spiking neurons and a broader range of neuromorphic and spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 实验与数值研究双自由层垂直磁隧道结（pMTJ），揭示其静态与动力学状态图及神经形态脉冲行为，并给出阈值电压的解析描述与优化准则。
AI.motivation: pMTJ的性能强烈依赖界面性质与层厚，微小变化即可显著改变磁性与输运特性；需要一种既保留进动动力学又简化制备的器件构型，并为人工脉冲神经元的多层MTJ堆栈优化提供指导。
AI.method: 制备并测试双自由层垂直MTJ；在磁场及直流/脉冲偏置下测量准静态状态图；用宏自旋模拟复现状态图；对Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）方程进行稳定性分析，导出临界线（含风车阈值电压）的解析表达式，并分析自旋转移矩电压依赖中的二次项。
AI.result: 状态图显示平行、反平行、双稳态三种静态区域，以及一个动力学“风车”区（一层翻转触发另一层翻转，产生类脉冲神经元信号）；宏自旋模拟与实验状态图吻合；解析模型给出临界线及风车阈值电压；发现自旋转移矩电压依赖中存在焦耳热无法解释的二次项。
AI.conclusion: 阈值电压可通过趋近自旋重取向转变（但牺牲热稳定性）或增强自旋转移矩的二次贡献来降低；结果为面向人工脉冲神经元及更广泛神经形态与自旋电子应用的多层MTJ堆栈优化确立了设计准则。

title: Quantum adiabatic and diabatic optimization: A Hilbert space engineering strategy with Rydberg arrays
summary: Neutral-atom arrays provide a versatile platform for encoding combinatorial optimization problems with arbitrary graph connectivity [Nguyen et al., PRX Quantum 4, 010316 (2023)]. Although the dynamics of individual encoding gadgets has been studied [Bombieri et al., PRX Quantum 6, 020306 (2025)], understanding annealing bottlenecks in larger networks remains challenging. We investigate how engineering the Hilbert-space geometry controls quantum annealing in a family of blockaded-chain models motivated by these encodings. While boundary terms encode the target maximum independent set problem, the bulk geometry induces an auxiliary optimization problem associated with independent sets of cliques. Spectrally, the energetics of the quantum system can be approximated by physically derived clique weights. When the target problem and the auxiliary problems are consistent, the low-energy modes lie predominantly within the target subspace. This spectral structure motivates a diabatic annealing strategy that exploits target-compatible excited states, as tested on the diamond-chain graph family. These results provide a framework for predicting annealing bottlenecks, and demonstrate Hilbert-space engineering as a strategy for improving neutral-atom quantum optimization protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阻塞链（blockaded-chain）模型中希尔伯特空间几何对量子退火的影响，用"团权重"近似系统能谱，提出可预测退火瓶颈的框架，并给出利用目标兼容激发态的非绝热退火策略。
AI.motivation: 中性原子阵列可编码任意连通性的组合优化问题，但现有工作多停留在单个编码小工具（gadget）的动力学层面，缺乏对较大网络中退火瓶颈的理解，亟需能预测瓶颈的物理图像。
AI.method: 构造一类受编码启发、由阻塞效应支配的链状模型：边界项编码目标最大独立集问题，体几何诱导与团（clique）独立集相关的辅助优化问题；通过物理推导的团权重近似量子系统的能谱，并分析低能模的空间分布；据此设计利用目标兼容激发态的非绝热（diabatic）退火策略，在钻石链（diamond-chain）图族上检验。
AI.result: 当目标问题与辅助问题一致时，低能模主要局域于目标子空间；团权重可较好地近似系统能谱结构；基于该谱结构设计的非绝热策略在钻石链图族上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 希尔伯特空间几何工程可作为分析和改善中性原子量子优化协议的有效策略，所提框架可用于预测退火瓶颈。

title: Quantum Coloring Games on Complete Graphs
summary:
We study the nonlocal game where two players are both given an input ($x$ and $y$, respectively), from a set of size $n$ and, without communicating, must give outputs $a$ and $b$, respectively, from a set of size $m < n$, winning when $(x = y) \leftrightarrow (a = b)$. This can be considered a graph coloring game on the complete graph with $n$ vertices. In the simplest case, the players get random equal inputs with probability $\frac{1}{2}$ and random unequal inputs otherwise.
  We solve this case of the game, and many others, for both classical and quantum (i.e., where the players may share finite-dimensional entangled quantum states) strategy sets, proving the value (the probability of winning) of the optimal strategies and providing explicit strategies that attain this optimum for all $n$ and $m$.
  Our optimal strategies are synchronous: i.e., the two players always give equal outputs when given equal inputs. These strategies remain optimal when the probability of receiving equal inputs is at least $\frac{2}{m + 2}$. Across this wide range of cases, we find that quantum strategies have an advantage over classical strategies exactly when $m$ does not divide $n$; this advantage is $O\left(\frac{m}{n^2}\right)$.

AI.tldr: 研究"相等-相等"(equality)非局域博弈：双方各得输入 x,y∈[n]，输出 a,b∈[m]（m<n），当 (x=y)↔(a=b) 时获胜；等价于完全图 K_n 的着色游戏。作者对该博弈（含等输入概率为 1/2 的最简情形及更一般情形）在经典与量子策略集下精确求解，给出最优获胜概率与达到最优的显式策略，并刻画量子优势的出现条件。
AI.motivation: 先前对 equality 类非局域博弈的分析多局限于特定参数或仅给出界，缺少对任意 n、m 的精确值与最优策略构造，也缺少对"量子优势何时出现、量级多大"的清晰刻画。本文旨在给出该博弈的完整解。
AI.method: 将博弈建模为 K_n 上的着色游戏，分别对经典（确定性/共享随机）与量子（共享有限维纠缠态、同步策略）策略集求解最优获胜概率；构造同步最优策略（等输入必给等输出），并把结论推广到等输入概率 p 的一般取值区间。
AI.result: 精确求出该博弈在经典与量子策略下的最优值（获胜概率），并对所有 n、m 给出达到最优的显式同步策略；该策略在等输入概率 p ≥ 2/(m+2) 时仍最优。量子策略优于经典策略当且仅当 m 不整除 n，且优势幅度为 O(m/n²)。
AI.conclusion: Equality 型非局域博弈可被完全求解；同步策略在很宽的输入分布区间内即为最优；量子优势的出现与否由整除关系 m | n 决定，且其量级随 n 增大而迅速衰减（O(m/n²)），说明在输出字母表远小于输入规模时量子优势极其微弱。

title: Logarithmic thermodynamic cost of prediction from rare observations
summary: A memory predicting changes in its environment from rare observations must spend energy on sampling and recording. We consider autonomous chemical memories driven by a sample-and-hold sensor observing an environment that switches at rate gamma, with sampling frequency f<<gamma. An ideal observer with access to the full observation history can retain predictive information proportional to f. However, retaining a finite fraction of this information in an autonomous physical memory requires work of order kBT ln(gamma/f) per sensor change. This additional thermodynamic cost arises from the competing requirements of suppressing false records during long intervals between observations and responding rapidly to new observations. We establish a universal low-power bound on predictive information, which grows at most as P/ln(P_ref/P) with power budget P, uniformly over any finite number of memory states and independently of network topology and memory relaxation times. We further demonstrate that memory architecture determines the attainable scaling. With bounded transition rates and readout from the memory alone, two-state memories are limited to P^2 scaling, whereas a three-state memory is sufficient to attain the optimal logarithmic scaling. Our results establish a fundamental thermodynamic distinction between acquiring information and maintaining a useful record of a changing environment.

AI.tldr: 自主化学记忆在"采样-保持"式感知下预测变化环境需付出 kBT ln(γ/f) 级热力学代价；预测信息量存在普适低功耗上界 P/ln(P_ref/P)，其可达标度由记忆结构决定：二态仅达 P²，三态即可实现最优对数标度。
AI.motivation: 自主物理记忆要从稀疏观测中预测环境变化，必须在采样与记录上耗能；已有研究多关注信息获取本身，缺乏对"维持可用记录"所必需的热力学代价及其与记忆架构关系的定量刻画。
AI.method: 构建由 sample-and-hold 传感器驱动的自主化学记忆模型，环境以速率 γ 切换、采样频率 f≪γ；以理想观察者（拥有完整观测史，可保留正比于 f 的预测信息）为参照，分析在有限状态记忆中以动力学方式保留信息所需的最小功；进一步比较不同状态数与网络拓扑下的可达标度。
AI.result: 在有限量级之内保留理想预测信息需要每次传感变化约 kBT ln(γ/f) 的功，源于"抑制长间隔中的虚假记录"与"快速响应新观测"的相互竞争。得到普适低功耗上界：功率预算 P 下预测信息最多按 P/ln(P_ref/P) 增长，且与状态数、网络拓扑、记忆弛豫时间无关。进一步，在跃迁速率有界且仅从记忆读出时，二态记忆受限于 P² 标度，三态记忆即足以达到最优对数标度。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了"获取信息"与"维持关于变化环境的有用记录"之间的基本热力学区分，并表明记忆架构（状态数）而非仅能量预算决定可实现的标度。

title: Electrical transport of surface-bound electrons on annealed solid neon
summary: We study the dc transport of electrons bound to the surface of solid neon using the conventional Sommer-Tanner method. First, we find that the capacitive cross-talk for the thickness of solid samples on the order of a millimeter varies substantially with the temperature and is strongly affected by the sample annealing. Second, we find that, even for the annealed samples, the observed response of electrons differs significantly from that of the surface-bound electrons on liquid helium and cannot be satisfactorily described by conventional models. Despite this, we managed to extract the resistance of the electron system from its in-phase response and investigate the temperature dependence in a wide range between 1.4 and 20 K. In a high-temperature range between 16 and 20 K, the resistance behavior is found to agree very well with the vapor-atom scattering mechanism, while at lower temperatures it is consistent with temperature-dependent scattering by surface roughness. Our analysis indicates a high electron mobility of electrons on solid neon but two orders of magnitude lower density than expected. These results suggest surface electrons as a suitable probe for studying the morphology of the neon surface but call for a better understanding of the experimental method applicable to such systems.

AI.tldr: 采用Sommer-Tanner方法研究束缚于固态氖表面的电子的直流输运，发现毫米级样品的电容串扰随温度显著变化且受退火强烈影响；即便退火样品，其响应也与液氦表面电子显著不同、难以用常规模型描述；从同相响应中提取电阻并在1.4–20 K范围研究温度依赖：16–20 K符合蒸气原子散射机制，低温符合表面粗糙度散射；分析表明固态氖表面电子迁移率较高但密度比预期低两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 将表面电子作为研究固态氖表面形貌的探针，并检验常规Sommer-Tanner方法在固态氖体系中的适用性。
AI.method: 使用传统Sommer-Tanner电容耦合方法测量固态氖表面束缚电子的直流输运，考察电容串扰随温度与退火的变化，并从同相响应中提取电子体系电阻，在1.4–20 K宽温区分析其温度依赖。
AI.result: 毫米级厚度固态样品的电容串扰随温度明显变化并受退火强烈影响；退火样品的电子响应仍与液氦表面电子差异显著，常规模型无法满意描述；16–20 K电阻行为与蒸气原子散射机制吻合良好，低温下与温度依赖的表面粗糙度散射一致；分析显示固态氖上电子迁移率较高，但密度比预期低约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 表面电子可作为研究氖表面形貌的合适探针，但亟需更好地理解适用于该类体系的实验方法。

title: Witnessing Magic (and other Quantum Resources)
summary: Motivated by measurements of quantum magic, we study the sampling cost of resource robustness ---a quantifier for a broad class of quantum resources--- by bounding the variance of optimal robustness witnesses. We first lower bound the samples required to estimate a state's resource robustness using Cramér-Rao bounds. We find that the number of measurements scales at least quadratically in the robustness for highly mixed states, and at least linearly in the generalized robustness for broad families of pure states, making it difficult to measure either robustness to low absolute error when the states are highly resourceful. We then derive two complementary bounds in terms of the geometry of witnesses, one of which is tight for a class of resource theories including coherence and bipartite entanglement. An additional hurdle occurs for tracking the onset of resource robustness along state-space trajectories: the integrated witness variance along a path is at least the squared resource gain over Fisher length, indicating that a state evolution with exponential resource gain necessarily goes through states for which the robustness cannot be measured efficiently. This hurdle does not occur when estimating robustness to fixed relative, rather than absolute, error. These results suggest that the ideal witness-based resource estimation task, for general resource theories, is the estimation of generalized robustness to low relative error on highly resourceful pure states.

AI.tldr: 量子资源鲁棒性的估计存在不可避免的采样开销：高混合态需样本数至少随鲁棒性平方增长，纯态随广义鲁棒性至少线性增长；沿轨迹追踪资源增长时，指数增长必然经过鲁棒性无法高效估计的态；但固定相对误差的估计可规避该障碍。
AI.motivation: 受量子"魔力"（magic）测量的启发，作者希望量化一大类量子资源度量——资源鲁棒性（resource robustness）——的采样成本，即估计该量所需的测量次数，从而判断在何种情形下基于见证量的资源估计任务是可行的。
AI.method: 以最优鲁棒性见证量的方差上界为核心工具：先用Cramér-Rao界给出估计态鲁棒性所需样本数的下界；再给出两种基于见证量几何结构的互补界，其中一种对相干性与二体纠缠等资源理论是紧的；此外分析沿态空间轨迹追踪鲁棒性起始（on set）情形，以路径上积分见证方差与Fisher长度的关系给出下界。
AI.result: 样本数下界：对高度混合态，测量次数至少随鲁棒性平方缩放；对广泛族类的纯态，至少随广义鲁棒性线性缩放，故在高资源态下以低绝对误差测量鲁棒性很困难。几何界方面，其中一界对相干、二体纠缠等资源理论紧致。轨迹情形中，路径上的积分见证方差至少为资源增益平方除以Fisher长度，因此资源指数增长的演化必然经过鲁棒性无法高效测量的态。若改为固定相对误差，则该障碍不出现。
AI.conclusion: 对一般资源理论而言，理想的基于见证量的资源估计任务应当是在高资源纯态上以低相对误差估计广义鲁棒性。

title: Exact environment checkpointing for memory-limited DMRG and TDVP
summary: Finite matrix-product-state sweep algorithms, such as the density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and the time-dependent variational principle (TDVP), store one environment tensor per site. At the bond dimensions needed for frustrated and two-dimensional systems this stack, rather than the state itself, exhausts the memory of the device. We adapt checkpointing to these sweeps: every $k$-th environment is kept, with $k\approx\sqrt{N}$ for $N$ sites, and the blocks in between are rebuilt when the sweep returns to them. The rebuild repeats the original contractions, so energies and states are reproduced bit for bit when the contractions are deterministic. Environment memory falls by 4.6-10x on cylinders of 96-384 sites. Bond-dimension searches with an implementation that rebuilds checkpoints at each half-sweep give gains of 1.77 for one level and 2.07 for two levels with eight contraction chunks on a single 141 GB GPU, using a 144-site triangular $J_1$-$J_2$ cylinder and stored baselines with matching chunking. Separate timings with checkpoints retained across half-sweeps give a one-level overhead of 6-15%, depending on the local eigensolver. At $D=1536$ the two-level schedule with eight chunks takes 1.42 times the sweep time of the equally chunked stored baseline, or 1.79 times that of the unchunked stored baseline. Simple models of the memory and the run time reproduce the measurements to within a few per cent. Unlike offloading, the method needs no host memory or disk, and the two can be combined. Implementations are provided for ITensorMPS.jl, TeNPy, MPSKit.jl and quimb.

AI.tldr: 将检查点(checkpointing)技术引入有限MPS扫描算法(DMRG、TDVP)，每隔约√N个格点保存一个环境张量，中间块在扫描回到时重建，从而大幅降低环境张量内存占用且结果逐位一致。
AI.motivation: 有限MPS扫描算法(如DMRG、TDVP)需为每个格点存一个环境张量，在阻挫体系与二维体系所需的大键维下，这一环境张量栈(而非量子态本身)成为显存/内存瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用检查点策略：每隔k个环境保存一个(k≈√N，N为格点数)，其余块在扫描返回时按原有收缩重新计算；重建重复原始收缩路径，因此在确定性收缩下能量与态逐位重现。另引入半扫描(half-sweep)间保留检查点与多级(multi-level)调度、收缩分块(chunking)等实现变体。
AI.result: 在96–384格点柱面上环境内存降低4.6–10倍；在单块141 GB GPU上、144格点三角J1-J2柱面上，半扫描重建检查点的键维搜索获得1.77(一级)与2.07(两级、8个收缩块)的加速；跨半扫描保留检查点时一级开销仅6–15%；D=1536时两级八块调度耗时分别为等分块存储基线的1.42倍与未分块基线的1.79倍；内存与运行时间简易模型误差在数个百分点内。
AI.conclusion: 检查点法显著缓解MPS扫描的环境内存压力，且无需主机内存或磁盘(区别于offloading)，可与offloading组合使用。已在ITensorMPS.jl、TeNPy、MPSKit.jl和quimb中提供实现。

title: Efficient Finite-Temperature Krylov Methods Based on Imaginary-Time Evolution
summary: We develop two finite-temperature Krylov methods that construct Krylov subspaces using imaginary-time evolution rather than direct applications of the Hamiltonian. The finite-temperature imaginary-time Lanczos method (FTiTL) applies the Lanczos method to the imaginary-time evolution operator, whereas the finite-temperature imaginary-time Krylov method (FTiTK) constructs a generalized eigenvalue problem using a nonorthogonal Krylov basis. We evaluate the accuracy and computational efficiency of these methods for the square-lattice transverse-field Ising model, using exact diagonalization for $N=16$ and quantum Monte Carlo results for $N=32$ as references. With appropriately chosen imaginary-time steps, both methods achieve higher accuracy than the conventional finite-temperature Lanczos method (FTLM) with fewer local operator applications in the ferromagnetic regime and near the quantum critical point. For $N=32$, FTiTL requires approximately half as many local operator applications as FTLM to achieve a root-mean-square error of $10^{-2}$ or less in the specific heat $C/N$. Furthermore, FTiTK can be implemented using only one state vector of full Hilbert-space dimension, halving the memory required for storing state vectors relative to FTLM.

AI.tldr: 提出两种基于虚时演化的有限温度Krylov方法（FTiTL与FTiTK），在横场Ising模型上比传统FTLM更省算力且更省内存。
AI.motivation: 传统有限温度Lanczos方法（FTLM）需反复直接作用哈密顿量来构建Krylov子空间，计算与存储开销较大，需寻找更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 用虚时演化算子替代哈密顿量的直接作用来构建Krylov子空间：FTiTL对虚时演化算子施加Lanczos过程；FTiTK用非正交Krylov基构造广义本征值问题。以方形晶格横场Ising模型为测试对象，N=16用精确对角化、N=32用量子蒙特卡罗作参考，评估精度与效率。
AI.result: 在选取合适虚时步长时，两法在铁磁区与量子临界点附近均比FTLM精度更高且局域算子作用次数更少；N=32时，欲使比热C/N的均方根误差≤10^-2，FTiTL所需局域算子作用次数约为FTLM的一半；FTiTK仅需一个满Hilbert空间维度的态矢量，态矢量存储内存减半。
AI.conclusion: 基于虚时演化的Krylov方法在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低计算与内存成本，是FTLM的有效替代方案。

title: Theory of anisotropic magnetotransport beyond the constant relaxation-time approximation in multi-Weyl semimetals
summary: Multi-Weyl semimetals, characterized by Weyl nodes carrying higher monopole charges, provide a platform for exploring topological magnetotransport beyond the conventional Weyl paradigm. Here, we develop a generalized semiclassical Boltzmann framework for multi-Weyl semimetals with arbitrary monopole charge $N$, incorporating the orbital magnetic moment (OMM) into the quasiparticle dispersion and Berry-curvature-modified dynamics, together with a momentum-dependent collision integral accounting for intra- and intervalley scattering. We investigate the longitudinal magnetoconductivity (LMC) and planar Hall conductivity (PHC) for $N=1$, $2$, and $3$, considering both nonmagnetic and magnetic impurity scattering. In the absence of OMM, the LMC remains positive and quadratic in the magnetic field throughout the investigated scattering regime, consistent with conventional chiral-anomaly-assisted transport. Including OMM, however, leads to a sign reversal of the LMC under sufficiently strong intervalley scattering for the $σ_0$ and $σ_z$ impurity channels. Remarkably, the critical intervalley scattering strength decreases systematically with increasing monopole charge, indicating an enhanced tendency toward negative LMC in higher-charge Weyl systems. Furthermore, we find that the PHC also undergoes a sign reversal for $N=2$ and $N=3$ in the same impurity channels, while remaining positive for $N=1$ within the investigated parameter range. The angular dependences retain their characteristic $\sin^2γ$-like and $\sin2γ$ profiles for LMC and PHC, respectively, even across the sign reversal. Our results demonstrate that the interplay of Berry curvature, OMM, monopole charge, and impurity scattering can produce qualitatively distinct weak-field magnetotransport responses beyond the conventional chiral-anomaly picture.

AI.tldr: 建立含轨道磁矩与动量依赖碰撞积分的广义半经典玻尔兹曼框架，研究任意单极荷 N 的多外尔半金属磁输运，发现 OMM 在强谷间散射下可导致 LMC 与 PHC 变号。
AI.motivation: 多外尔半金属的节点携带更高单极荷，其弱场磁输运超出传统手征反常图像；现有理论多忽略轨道磁矩（OMM）及谷间散射的动量依赖性，缺乏对 N>1 体系的统一描述。
AI.method: 构建任意单极荷 N 的广义半经典玻尔兹曼框架：将 OMM 计入准粒子色散与贝里曲率修正的动力学方程，并采用动量依赖的碰撞积分同时处理谷内与谷间散射；对 N=1,2,3 分别计算纵向磁导（LMC）与平面霍尔导（PHC），涵盖非磁性与磁性杂质（σ0、σz 通道）。
AI.result: 无 OMM 时，LMC 在所研究的散射区间恒为正且随磁场二次增长，符合手征反常辅助输运；引入 OMM 后，在 σ0 与 σz 杂质通道中足够强的谷间散射使 LMC 变号，且临界谷间散射强度随单极荷增大而系统性降低。PHC 在 N=2、3 时同样变号，而 N=1 在参数范围内保持为正；变号前后角度依赖仍保持 LMC 的 sin²γ 型与 PHC 的 sin2γ 型分布。
AI.conclusion: 贝里曲率、OMM、单极荷与杂质散射的协同作用可在弱场区产生定性区别于传统手征反常图像的磁输运响应，单极荷增大增强了负 LMC 倾向。

title: Control of Non-Markovianity via Channel Exceptional Points in a Driven-Dissipative Kerr-Cat Qubit
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) in open quantum systems are conventionally defined at the Liouvillian level, making them representation-dependent and often requiring auxiliary degrees of freedom. We study EPs directly at the quantum-channel level in a driven-dissipative Kerr-cat qubit, in which dissipation drives bidirectional jumps between its two basis states. Interpolating two Markovian channels yields single EPs when the endpoints straddle a spectral-phase boundary and, remarkably, double EPs within the same phase. The interpolated EPs map out a Markovian--non-Markovian phase diagram: the parameter plane separates certified non-Markovian and Markovian domains, with domain boundaries switching the channel between the two characters. Three spectral criteria certify every domain. As the evolution time advances, the domains drift, split, and partially shrink, making the switching increasingly sensitive to parameters and time. This establishes a representation-independent paradigm for classifying and switching quantum memory effects, applicable to continuous-variable, discrete-variable, and hybrid systems.

AI.tldr: 在Kerr-cat量子比特的信道层面而非Liouvillian层面定义奇异点，通过两马尔可夫信道插值获得单/双EP，并据此构建马尔可夫—非马尔可夫相图与切换机制。
AI.motivation: 传统开放量子系统的奇异点（EP）定义在Liouvillian层面，依赖具体表示且往往需要引入辅助自由度，缺乏表示无关的刻画工具；同时量子信道的马尔可夫/非马尔可夫性质判定与切换也缺少统一的奇异点视角。
AI.method: 在驱动耗散Kerr-cat量子比特中，于量子信道层面直接研究EP：耗散驱动两个基态之间的双向跳跃；对两个马尔可夫信道进行插值，当端点跨越谱相位边界时得到单EP，而在同一相位内则得到双EP；用插值EP构建马尔可夫—非马尔可夫相图，并以三条谱判据对每个区域进行认证。
AI.result: 插值EP给出相图，参数平面被划分为认证的非马尔可夫域与马尔可夫域，域边界处信道在两种性质间切换；三条谱判据可认证全部区域；随演化时间推进，各域发生漂移、分裂与部分收缩，使切换对参数和时间的敏感性增强。
AI.conclusion: 建立了与表示无关的量子奇异点框架，用于分类与切换量子记忆效应，可推广至连续变量、离散变量及混合系统。

authors: Erin E. Fleck Jonathan A. Sobota
title: Spectroscopic evidence for unconventional surface magnetism in the Kondo insulator FeSb$_2$
summary: Kondo insulators have a non-magnetic bulk due to many-body screening of local moment by conduction electrons. However, the surface of these systems has reduced density of itinerant electrons and may experience a Kondo breakdown, leading to recovery of non-zero local moments and possible magnetic order. Here we use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate the (010) surface of a $d$-$p$ electron Kondo insulator FeSb$_2$, which is predicted to host a bulk $d$-wave altermagnetic state in the absence of Kondo screening. We find anisotropic splitting on the surface states with a maximum in the $k_z$ direction and a minimum in the $k_x$ direction. The splitting is apparently suppressed with increasing temperature or with Te doping, suggesting that the splitting arises from a magnetic order rather than Rashba effects. Considering the proximity of the bulk to a $d$-wave altermagnetic state and considering the symmetry of the crystal on the surface, we postulate that our observations may be consistent with an emergent surface altermagnetic order. Such an unconventional 2-dimensional magnetic order naturally hosted on an insulating, non-magnet bulk substrate may offer a promising platform for versatile applications.

AI.tldr: 利用ARPES研究d-p电子型近藤绝缘体FeSb₂的(010)表面，发现表面态各向异性劈裂（k_z方向最大、k_x最小），随温度升高和Te掺杂而减弱，推测源自表面涌现的d波交变磁序。
AI.motivation: 近藤绝缘体体内因传导电子对局域矩的多体屏蔽而呈非磁性，但表面巡游电子密度降低，可能发生近藤击穿、恢复局域矩并产生磁序；FeSb₂在无近藤屏蔽时被预言具有体d波交变磁态，可借此检验表面磁性。
AI.method: 对FeSb₂(010)表面进行角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)测量，分析表面态劈裂的动量方向各向异性，并改变温度与进行Te掺杂作为对照实验，以区分磁序与Rashba效应。
AI.result: 表面态出现各向异性劈裂，最大值沿k_z方向、最小值沿k_x方向；该劈裂随温度升高或Te掺杂而明显抑制，表明确非Rashba型自旋轨道效应所致。
AI.conclusion: 结合体态邻近d波交变磁态及表面晶体对称性，观测结果可能与表面涌现的交变磁序一致；这种自然存在于绝缘非磁体衬底上的二维非常规磁序有望成为多功能应用平台。

title: Noise-induced manifolds: reduction of slow--fast SDEs to switching processes
summary: When constituents copy one another, as in reaction networks, collective behaviour and opinion dynamics, the noise of copying vanishes at consensus and can make a system bistable. More generally this noise vanishes on whole manifolds, along which slower variables keep moving and set the switching rates, yet no general method derives these switching dynamics. Here we reduce slow--fast stochastic differential equations whose fast noise acts in a single direction to a switching diffusion or piecewise-deterministic Markov process (PDMP), using the absorption probabilities of the fast noise in place of an invariant measure, and derive a first-order correction for the finite duration of switches. For the two-species Togashi--Kaneko model the reduction recovers our earlier PDMP, and the correction captures how the stationary composition depends on the timescale separation. In a model of foraging ants with a depleting food source, the hazard of leaving a source rises through every stay, which makes the colony unlikely to leave a source soon after arriving there.

AI.tldr: 将快噪声仅作用于单一方向的慢-快随机微分方程约化为切换扩散或分段确定性马尔可夫过程(PDMP)，用快噪声的吸收概率替代不变测度，并给出有限切换时长的一阶修正。
AI.motivation: 复制型噪声在共识处（乃至整个流形上）消失，导致系统双稳；慢变量沿噪声零流形继续演化并决定切换速率，但目前缺乏推导这类切换动力学的通用方法。
AI.method: 针对快噪声方向单一的慢-快SDE，以快过程的吸收概率（而非不变测度）构造约化切换扩散/PDMP，并对切换持续时间有限引入一阶修正；应用于双物种Togashi–Kaneko模型及食物耗竭下的觅食蚁模型。
AI.result: 在Togashi–Kaneko模型中约化复现了此前的PDMP，且修正项刻画了平稳组成对时间尺度分离度的依赖；在觅食蚁模型中，离开食物源的危害率随停留时间的每次延续而上升，使蚁群在刚到达后不太可能很快离开。
AI.conclusion: 吸收概率是处理噪声零流形上切换动力学的有效工具，所提出的约化与一阶修正框架具有通用性并可推广至更广泛的慢-快随机系统。

title: Exciton-polarons in monolayer semiconductors with drifting electrons
summary: Recent work has demonstrated that the optical absorption of moderately doped two-dimensional semiconductors can be described in terms of exciton-polarons. In this picture, interactions between a photoexcited exciton and a Fermi sea of excess charge carriers split the exciton spectrum into a lower-energy attractive polaron branch and a higher-energy repulsive polaron branch. Due to the negligible in-plane momentum of photons, however, optical measurements probe only exciton-polarons near zero momentum, leaving their finite-momentum physics largely unexplored. Here we propose accessing this regime by measuring the absorption in the presence of an electric bias current. In effect, this displaces the electronic Fermi sea in momentum space, such that an optically active exciton-polaron at rest acquires finite momentum relative to the charge carriers. Using a diagrammatic formulation of the exciton-polaron problem, we derive exact relations between the spectral and quasiparticle properties of current-biased exciton-polarons and their finite-momentum counterparts in an equilibrium Fermi sea. These relations show that absorption measurements with drifting electrons can reconstruct the momentum dependence of the quasiparticle properties for both branches. We estimate that experimentally accessible currents can probe a broad momentum range while remaining within the linear-response regime.

AI.tldr: 提出通过加偏置电流使费米海在动量空间平移，从而用光吸收测量探测有限动量激子极化子，并给出电流偏置与平衡态有限动量谱/准粒子性质之间的精确关系。
AI.motivation: 光子在面内动量近乎为零，光学测量只能探测零动量附近的激子极化子，其有限动量物理长期缺乏实验手段。
AI.method: 以激子极化子问题的图解（diagrammatic）形式化为基础，推导电流偏置下激子极化子的谱函数与准粒子性质同平衡费米海中有限动量对应量之间的精确关系。
AI.result: 所得关系表明，漂移电子下的吸收测量可重构吸引与排斥两支极化子的准粒子性质随动量的依赖；估算显示实验可达电流即可覆盖较宽动量范围，且仍处于线性响应区。
AI.conclusion: 电流偏置吸收谱是一种探测激子极化子有限动量物理的可行方案。

title: Machine-learned active spaces enable quantum calculations of spin-state energetics of transition-metal complexes on quantum hardware
comment: 37 pages, 21 figures; Supplementary Information (54 pages) included
summary: Multireference calculations on transition-metal complexes, on classical or quantum hardware, depend on the choice of active space. The orbitals that belong in it are those that are strongly entangled in the correlated wavefunction, but measuring this entanglement requires the very correlated calculation that the active space is meant to make affordable. Here we present SpinAware, a machine-learning model that predicts density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) single-orbital entropies and orbital-pair mutual information from the unrestricted Hartree-Fock (UHF) solution of each spin state, without any correlated calculation. Each of the 20 highest occupied and 20 lowest unoccupied orbitals is described by 60 descriptors computed from the UHF solution, among them the differences between its alpha and beta occupations and energies, its metal-d and ligand character, and its exchange coupling to the other orbitals, and a transformer predicts the entropy of each orbital in the context of all others. Trained on 3454 spin-pure DMRG calculations on mononuclear Cr-Ni complexes, the model transfers to experimentally characterized complexes with ligands, binding topologies, oxidation states and metals absent from training. Over 11 spin states it reproduces the DMRG entropy profiles with a mean absolute error of 0.027, and combining the predicted entropies with the predicted mutual information gives a candidate pool that contains 99% of the DMRG-active orbitals of the benchmark spin states while keeping, on average, only 15 of the 40 orbitals. Natural-orbital occupation scans then select compact active spaces from this pool for a nickel and a cobalt complex. Sample-based quantum diagonalization with samples from IBM quantum processors reproduces the exact CASCI energies of these spaces to within 0.3 kcal/mol and their spin-state gaps to within 0.10 kcal/mol for up to 32 qubits.

AI.tldr: 提出SpinAware，用UHF解描述符+Transformer直接预测DMRG单轨道熵与轨道对互信息，无需相关计算即可构建紧凑活性空间。
AI.motivation: 多参考计算（经典或量子硬件上的过渡金属配合物）依赖活性空间选择；真正决定轨道是否入选的强纠缠量只能通过昂贵相关计算获得，形成"为选活性空间需先做相关计算"的循环依赖。
AI.method: 对每种自旋态，取能量最高的20个占据与最低的20个空轨道，各用60个来自UHF解的描述符（α/β占据数与能量差、金属d与配体特征、与其他轨道的交换耦合等）刻画，送入Transformer在全轨道集合上下文中预测单轨道熵；再结合预测的轨道对互信息构建候选轨道池；随后用自然轨道占据数扫描从中挑选紧凑活性空间；最后用IBM量子处理器的采样量子对角化（SQD）验证。
AI.result: 在3454个单核Cr–Ni配合物的自旋纯DMRG计算上训练，可迁移到配体、配位拓扑、氧化态与金属均未见过的实验表征配合物；11个自旋态上熵分布复现MAE为0.027；候选池以平均仅15/40个轨道覆盖99%的DMRG活性轨道；对Ni、Co配合物，SQD在≤32量子比特下复现精确CASCI能量误差<0.3 kcal/mol，自旋态能隙误差<0.10 kcal/mol。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习可从平均场解预测纠缠量，实现无相关计算的活性空间选择，并与量子采样对角化衔接，形成端到端的多参考量子化学流程。

title: Dynamical theory of the East model. I. A review on the Zwanzig-Mori projection-operator formalism
summary: The East model is a paradigmatic kinetically constrained spin model in one dimension that exhibits glassy dynamics. This review surveys the progress on the theoretical description of the dynamics of the East model, focusing on the spin time correlation function and the relaxation time. We summarize rigorous results on the super-Arrhenius scaling of the relaxation time in the low-temperature limit. We then present a unified derivation of the Zwanzig-Mori projection-operator formalism for both the fluctuation and domain bases. Within this formalism, an infinite hierarchy of coupled equations for the time correlation function and memory kernels emerges---a structure reminiscent of generalized mode-coupling theory developed for supercooled liquids. We review the analytical approximations obtained by truncating or closing the hierarchy at first or second orders and compare them against Monte Carlo simulations. Although these approaches perform reasonably at moderate temperatures, they universally fail in the low-temperature regime: mode-coupling closure schemes in the fluctuation basis introduce spurious ergodicity-breaking transitions, while truncations in the domain basis discard slower modes and fail to capture the asymptotic divergence of the relaxation time. The loss of analytical tractability beyond second order remains the central obstacle, underscoring the fundamental difficulty of describing hierarchical relaxation even in this ``simplest'' model of glassy dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文综述一维East模型（动力学约束自旋模型）动力学的理论描述进展，重点为自旋时间关联函数与弛豫时间；总结低温弛豫时间超Arrhenius标度的严格结果，统一推导涨落基与畴基下的Zwanzig-Mori投影算符形式，并评述低阶截断近似与模拟的对比。
AI.motivation: East模型是研究玻璃态动力学"最简"范例，但即便在该模型中，层级式弛豫的解析描述仍十分困难；需要系统梳理已有理论工具（严格结果、投影算符形式、模式耦合型闭合）的有效范围与失效机制，明确瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 综述性研究：梳理弛豫时间低温极限超Arrhenius标度的严格结果；在涨落基与畴基两种基底下统一推导Zwanzig-Mori投影算符形式，得到时间关联函数与记忆核的无限耦合方程层级（类似广义模式耦合理论）；考察一阶、二阶截断或闭合的解析近似，并与Monte Carlo模拟比较。
AI.result: 各近似在中等温度表现尚可，但在低温区普遍失效：涨落基下的模式耦合闭合方案引入虚假的遍历性破缺转变；畴基下的截断丢弃了更慢的模式，无法捕捉弛豫时间的渐近发散。
AI.conclusion: 二阶以上解析可处理性的丧失是核心障碍，说明即使在玻璃态动力学的"最简"模型中，描述层级式弛豫也存在根本性困难。

title: Optical spin Edelstein response of d-wave altermagnets
summary: The momentum-dependent spin splitting and compensated magnetic order in altermagnets offer opportunities for electrical control of spin polarization. We explore the spin Edelstein effect in the frequency domain of a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet with Rashba spin-orbit coupling. We calculate the spin-velocity susceptibility response function beyond the intraband response regime and find that the interband longitudinal and transverse Edelstein responses are governed by the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature, respectively. The density of states presents a logarithmic van Hove singularity at exactly the negative value of the energy below which four disconnected Fermi contours emerge. This defines three distinctive regions for the position of the Fermi level, through which the Edelstein susceptibility tensor displays characteristic spectral features, reflecting the topological change of the Fermi surface. The resulting spin magnetization shows a strong dependence on the driving frequency and on the orientation of the in-plane external electric field. Our results highlight new possibilities for electrical and optical control of the spin Edelstein effect in altermagnets that could find spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 研究二维d波交变磁体（altermagnet）在Rashba自旋轨道耦合下的自旋Edelstein效应，揭示带间纵向/横向响应分别由Zeeman量子度规与Zeeman贝里曲率支配，并给出费米能级三个区域的特征谱学与自旋磁化对频率和电场方向的依赖。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体中动量依赖的自旋劈裂与补偿磁序为实现自旋极化的电学调控提供了机会，但超越带内响应范畴的带间自旋Edelstein效应及其与费米面拓扑变化的关联尚不清楚，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 构建含Rashba自旋轨道耦合的二维d波交变磁体模型，计算自旋-速度磁化率响应函数（超出带内响应近似），将带间Edelstein响应与量子几何量（Zeeman量子度规、Zeeman贝里曲率）对应，并结合态密度与费米面拓扑分析其谱学特征。
AI.result: 带间纵向与横向Edelstein响应分别由Zeeman量子度规和Zeeman贝里曲率决定；态密度在某一负能量处出现对数van Hove奇点，该能量以下出现四条互不相连的费米轮廓，从而将费米能级划分为三个区域，Edelstein磁化率张量在这些区域呈现特征性谱学行为；自旋磁化强烈依赖驱动频率与面内外加电场取向。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁体中自旋Edelstein效应可由电场与光场有效调控，量子几何量（Zeeman量子度规与贝里曲率）是理解其带间响应的核心，为自旋电子学应用提供新途径。

title: Constrained Adiabatic Quantum Programming
summary: To find a $k$-clique in a graph, adiabatic quantum computation (AQC) evolves a quantum system from the minimum of an initial cost function to the minimum of a problem cost function that penalizes non-cliques. Existing AQC languages fix the initial cost function, so the search ranges over all $2^n$ subsets of the $n$ vertices, although only the subsets of size $k$ can be answers. We present ENQ+, an AQC language in which the programmer writes both cost functions. Data constraints define the problem cost function. Relational constraints, a new construct, declare the moves the search may make between configurations and define the initial cost function. For the clique, a single relational constraint, which exchanges a chosen vertex with an unchosen one, confines the search to the subsets of size $k$. ENQ+ thereby turns constrained quantum annealing, which physicists set up by hand for individual problems, into a programming construct. We give ENQ+ a semantics in many-world configuration (MWC) graphs, whose nodes are configurations and whose edges are moves, and derive from it a step-wise semantics of adiabatic evolution. We prove that a run stays within the component of the MWC graph that contains its initial state, and that a run from an approximate initial state still reaches the answer, with probability equal to its squared overlap with the exact one. We compile ENQ+ to quantum circuits, prove the compilation correct with respect to the semantics, and use ENQ+ to program the Three-Dimensional Matching, Hamiltonian Cycle, and Traveling Salesperson problems.

AI.tldr: 提出 ENQ+ 绝热量子计算语言，允许程序员同时编写初始与问题代价函数，用"关系约束"把搜索限制在可行子集内。
AI.motivation: 现有 AQC 语言固定初始代价函数，导致 k-团搜索遍历全部 2^n 个子集，而仅 C(n,k) 个大小为 k 的子集可能是答案，搜索空间冗余巨大；物理学家为具体问题手工设置约束量子退火，缺乏编程抽象。
AI.method: ENQ+ 中数据约束定义问题代价函数，关系约束（新构造）声明配置间的移动并定义初始代价函数；以多世界配置（MWC）图给出语义，节点为配置、边为移动，并导出逐步绝热演化语义；证明运行保持在其初始状态所在的 MWC 图连通分量内，证明从近似初始态出发仍以与精确态平方重叠的概率到达答案；将 ENQ+ 编译为量子电路并证明编译相对语义的正确性。
AI.result: 对 k-团，单条交换已选/未选顶点的关系约束即把搜索限制在大小 k 的子集内；完成编译正确性证明；用 ENQ+ 编写了三维匹配、哈密顿回路与旅行商问题。
AI.conclusion: ENQ+ 将需人工设置的约束量子退火转化为通用编程构造，兼顾表达力与可证明语义。

title: Angular dependence of the low-temperature skyrmion state in Cu$_2$OSeO$_3$
summary: In the cubic chiral magnet Cu$_2$OSeO$_3$, a low-temperature skyrmion state (LTS) and a metastable tilted conical state emerge for magnetic field along $\langle 100\rangle$, both stabilized by magnetocrystalline anisotropies. We report how these states evolve when the magnetic field is rotated from $\langle 100\rangle$ via $\langle 111\rangle$ to $\langle 110\rangle$. Measurements of the magnetization and the AC susceptibility are combined with broadband microwave spectroscopy on the same cuboid sample at 5\,K. In the microwave spectra, the characteristic gigahertz excitations, notably the counterclockwise gyration mode of the skyrmions, provide a direct indicator of the character of the magnetic states and a qualitative measure of their volume fractions. Both techniques consistently show that signatures of the LTS decrease in strength under rotation and are observed only for field directions within ${\sim}20^{\circ}$ of $\langle 100\rangle$. In this range, the field values at which the skyrmions unwind remain essentially unchanged. In contrast, signatures of the tilted conical state persist up to ${\sim}40^{\circ}$, beyond which the conventional sequence of helical, conical, and field-polarized states is recovered. Thus, the tilted conical state, while being a prerequisite for the nucleation of the LTS under field sweeps, is not sufficient for its formation.

AI.tldr: 研究了Cu₂OSeO₃中磁场从⟨100⟩经⟨111⟩转向⟨110⟩时低温斯格明子态与倾斜锥形态的演化，发现LTS特征仅在⟨100⟩约20°内存在，倾斜锥形态可延伸至约40°，后者是LTS形核的必要条件但非充分条件。
AI.motivation: 立方手性磁体Cu₂OSeO₃在⟨100⟩方向磁场下存在由磁晶各向异性稳定的低温斯格明子态（LTS）和亚稳倾斜锥形态，但二者在磁场方向偏离⟨100⟩时的稳定性范围与相互关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 在同一长方体样品、5 K条件下，将磁化测量与交流磁化率测量同宽带微波谱学相结合，使磁场方向由⟨100⟩经⟨111⟩旋转至⟨110⟩，利用吉赫兹激发（特别是斯格明子的逆时针回旋模）作为磁状态性质及体积分数的判据。
AI.result: 两种技术一致表明：LTS特征随转角增大而减弱，仅在距⟨100⟩约20°以内可观测，且该范围内斯格明子解绕的磁场值基本不变；倾斜锥形态特征则持续至约40°，超过后恢复为常规的螺旋—锥形—场极化态序列。
AI.conclusion: 倾斜锥形态虽是在场扫描下LTS形核的先决条件，但并不充分；磁晶各向异性决定的态选择对LTS形成具有决定性作用。

title: A Free Energy Approach to Modelling Disordered Hyperuniform Patterns
summary: We present a free-energy-based approach for modelling disordered hyperuniform patterns. Specifically, we devise a phase-field crystal model with a correlation kernel that simultaneously selects for a continuous range of degenerate wave modes. At small wave vectors, we construct the correlation function by inverting the Ornstein-Zernike relation to approximate the structure factor of a hyperuniform pattern. Our model demonstrates a crossover between liquid, crystalline, quasicrystalline, and long-lived disordered states depending on the specified free energy parameter and driving force. We show that, for a fixed driving force, the specific structures and wave vectors selected by the density field can be controlled by modulating the width of the correlation kernel. Furthermore, we show that the scaling of the low-wave-vector region of the correlation function can accurately reproduce a specified hyperuniform exponent, independently of the structural properties at larger wave numbers. Our results establish a free-energy-based framework for describing disordered hyperuniform states, demonstrating and enabling independent control over structural selection and long-wavelength density correlations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于自由能的相场晶体模型，通过设计可同时选择连续简并波模的关联核，并结合Ornstein-Zernike反演，实现对无序超均匀图案的结构选择与长波密度关联的独立调控。
AI.motivation: 无序超均匀态缺乏基于自由能的统一描述框架，且结构选择与长波密度关联（超均匀指数）通常相互耦合、难以分别控制。
AI.method: 构建相场晶体（PFC）模型，其关联核在小波矢处通过反演Ornstein-Zernike关系近似目标超均匀图案的结构因子，并设计该核以同时选择一段连续简并波模；通过调节自由能参数、驱动力与关联核宽度考察相行为。
AI.result: 模型随自由能参数与驱动力呈现液态、晶态、准晶态与长寿命无序态之间的转变；固定驱动力时，调节关联核宽度可控制密度场选择的具体结构与波矢；关联函数低波矢段的标度可精确复现指定超均匀指数，且与大波数处结构性质无关。
AI.conclusion: 建立了描述无序超均匀态的自由能框架，实现结构选择与长波密度关联的独立控制。

title: Strain-Engineering Giant Pseudo-Electric Fields in Multilayer Graphene
summary: Electromagnetic scalar and vector potentials can be engineered in solids through lattice distortions, providing a versatile means of tuning electronic band structures. The pseudovector component, which generates pseudo-magnetic fields, has received much attention for its ability to realize a zero-field quantum Hall effect. However, the pseudoscalar component, giving rise to pseudo-electric fields to which many electronic systems are intrinsically susceptible, has not yet been experimentally explored. Here, we demonstrate the emergence and profound consequences of the pseudoscalar potential in a multilayer graphene system. Atomic relaxation reconstructs the system into large Bernalstacked domains separated by one-dimensional rhombohedral channels. Within this inter-dimensional system, we achieve the first direct atomic-scale imaging of distinct lattice deformations in graphene under strain. In rhombohedral channels, we observe that the tensile lattice deformation induces giant pseudo-electric fields, producing ultra-flat dispersion with divergent density of states and a large energy gap. This results in enhanced electronic correlations, leading to flat-band instabilities and striped modulation in the density of states that would otherwise require strong external displacement fields. Moreover, the gap opened by the pseudoscalar potential protects topological boundary states that persist in the absence of applied fields. Our results provide a comprehensive atomic-scale characterization of graphene elasticity and direct spectroscopic evidence for the nontrivial pseudo-electric field arising from lattice distortion. More broadly, it provides an intrinsic and tunable pathway to new quantum states

AI.tldr: 在多层石墨烯中，原子弛豫形成Bernal堆叠畴与一维菱方通道共存的结构；菱方通道内拉伸应变产生巨大赝电场，导致超平色散、发散态密度与大能隙，并诱发了条纹状态密度调制及无需外场即可存在的拓扑边界态。
AI.motivation: 固体中可通过晶格畸变构造电磁标量与矢量势，其中赝矢量势（赝磁场）已被广泛研究用于零场量子霍尔效应，而赝标量势（赝电场）虽被理论预期且多数电子系统对其敏感，却一直缺乏实验探索。
AI.method: 利用多层石墨烯体系，借助原子弛豫自然重构为Bernal堆叠畴与一维菱方（rhombohedral）通道构成"跨维度"结构；通过原子尺度成像直接观测应变下的晶格形变，并结合扫描隧道谱/谱学表征研究菱方通道中的电子结构。
AI.result: 首次实现石墨烯应变晶格形变的原子尺度直接成像；在菱方通道中观测到拉伸形变诱导的巨大赝电场，产生超平色散、发散态密度和较大能隙，增强电子关联并导致平带不稳定性与态密度的条纹状调制（通常需强外部位移场才能实现）；赝标量势打开的能隙可保护无外加场时仍存在的拓扑边界态。
AI.conclusion: 提供了石墨烯弹性的全面原子尺度表征，并给出晶格畸变产生非平庸赝电场的直接谱学证据，为利用本征、可调的方式实现新量子态提供了途径。

title: Efficient simulation of the generalized Langevin equation using a basis of dynamically relevant histories for memory and noise
summary: The Generalized Langevin Equation (GLE) is a cornerstone for modeling non-Markovian dynamics, but its numerical solution remains challenging due to the history-dependent convolution and the need to generate colored noise with a prescribed correlation function. We introduce a forward construction that addresses both challenges within a single framework. We represent an arbitrary trajectory as sum of relevant and irrelevant parts, where relevant part can be decomposed into a small number of characteristic history patterns that make the main contribution to future dynamics. It allows to reduce numerical cost to \(O(d^2)\) for $d$ chosen patterns instead of full history. The same construction applies to colored noise generation, where the causal filter plays the role of the memory kernel. We demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the method for several representative kernels, including long-range kernels with power-law tails.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"前向构造"框架，将非马尔可夫轨迹分解为少数特征历史模式之和，同时解决GLE的卷积记忆计算与有色噪声生成问题，数值代价降至O(d²)。
AI.motivation: 广义Langevin方程(GLE)是非马尔可夫动力学建模的基石，但数值求解困难：一是记忆核带来的历史依赖卷积，二是需生成具有指定关联函数的有色噪声，二者通常需分别处理、代价高昂。
AI.method: 将任意轨迹表示为相关部分与无关部分之和，相关部分可分解为少量"特征历史模式"(characteristic history patterns)，这些模式对未来动力学贡献最大，从而以d个模式替代完整历史，将代价降至O(d²)。同一构造通过将因果滤波器视作记忆核，直接用于有色噪声生成，实现两个问题在同一框架下的统一处理。
AI.result: 在包括幂律尾长程核在内的多种代表性记忆核上验证了方法的精度与效率。
AI.conclusion: 该前向构造为GLE数值求解提供了统一、低复杂度且可扩展的框架，兼顾记忆卷积加速与有色噪声生成，适用于长程核等挑战性情形。

title: Two channels of magnetic renormalization in the terahertz lattice response of FePS$_{3}$
summary: Interlayer vibrations probe how magnetic van der Waals layers are stacked and coupled. In the zigzag antiferromagnet FePS$_3$, ultrafast experiments show that the interlayer shear couples strongly to the magnetic order, but not how magnetism renormalizes the shear stiffness and damping. Here, using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, we measure the anisotropic conductivity of FePS$_3$ from 1.6 to 300 K and in fields up to 7 T normal to the layers. We observe absorption bands at 0.6-0.8 and 1.3-2.4 THz that persist into the paramagnetic phase. The lower one is consistent with an interlayer shear resonance; the magnetic order stiffens one of its in-plane components and softens the other, reversing their splitting at the Néel temperature. We identify two channels of magnetic renormalization: frequency shifts are confined to the ordered phase, whereas the linewidths of this resonance and most oscillator strengths follow short-range spin correlations persisting well above the transition. The field acts mainly on the higher resonance in one orientation: near 3.2 T, its softening accelerates and its linewidth has a cusp-like minimum, consistent with critical slowing down of a field-induced order parameter. These results give an equilibrium view of spin-shear coupling, which is anisotropic and persists above the Néel temperature through short-range correlations.

AI.tldr: 利用太赫兹时域光谱测量FePS₃在1.6–300 K、0–7 T下的各向异性电导，揭示层间剪切模式与磁序的耦合：频率移动仅存在于有序相，而线宽与振子强度跟随短程自旋关联延伸至奈尔温度以上。
AI.motivation: FePS₃中的层间剪切与磁序强耦合已有超快实验证据，但磁序如何重整化剪切刚度与阻尼缺乏平衡态、定量的认识，尤其是各向异性与短程关联的作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹时域光谱，在1.6–300 K温度区间及垂直层方向最高7 T磁场下测量FePS₃的各向异性电导，分辨0.6–0.8 THz与1.3–2.4 THz吸收带，并追踪其频率分裂、线宽与振子强度随温度和磁场的变化。
AI.result: 两吸收带在顺磁相仍存在；低频带符合层间剪切共振，磁序使其中一个面内分量变硬、另一个变软，并在奈尔温度处反转二者分裂。频率移动局限于有序相，而线宽及多数振子强度遵循延伸至转变温度以上的短程自旋关联。磁场主要作用于某一取向的高频共振：约3.2 T时软化加速、线宽出现尖点状极小，符合场诱导序参量的临界慢化。
AI.conclusion: 给出了自旋—剪切耦合的平衡态图像：该耦合具有各向异性，并通过短程关联在奈尔温度以上持续存在；磁重整化可分解为频率（有序相）与线宽/强度（短程关联）两条通道。

title: Renormalization group study of critical behavior of $O(m)$ model with cubic anisotropy and extended defects: two-loop approximation
summary: We study the impact of quenched extended defects correlated in $ε_d$ dimensions and randomly distributed in the remaining $d - ε_d$ dimensions on the critical properties of a $d$-dimensional $O(m)$-symmetric system with cubic anisotropy. Exploiting the field-theoretic renormalization-group approach within the minimal subtraction scheme, we compute the two-loop renormalization-group functions. Applying resummation techniques to analyze the asymptotic series, we estimate the marginal values of $ε_d$ above which disorder becomes relevant for the physically important cases $m = 2$ and $m = 3$ in $d = 3$. We report numerical values of the critical exponents for the disorder-induced universality classes.

AI.tldr: 采用场论重整化群（最小减除方案）计算两圈RG函数，研究ε_d维关联扩展缺陷对d维立方各向异性O(m)系统临界性质的影响，并用重求和估计无序相关性的临界ε_d值及新普适类的临界指数。
