AI.tldr: qlin 是一个经 Lean 4 形式化验证的动态量子电路编译器，通过将操作移出分支、把高概率 syndrome 编译为多路分支、并用代价模型决定经典/量子控制门替换，从而缩短测量-反馈等待时间；65 个基准中 10 个提速≥10%（最高 91.2%），distance-5 重复码解码器在 QubiC RTL 上由 151.1 周期降至 21.3 周期。
AI.motivation: 动态量子电路在运行中测量量子比特并依据结果选择后续操作，导致量子比特必须等待测量结果传到经典控制器、控制器再做出决策。这段等待（反馈延迟）成为运行时间瓶颈，而现有编译工作较少针对该等待时间进行系统性优化。
AI.method: 1) 将操作移出条件分支且不延迟程序，该性质在 Lean 4 中给出机器检验证明；2) 针对 syndrome 几乎总为零的纠错解码器，把高概率 syndrome 编译成单个多路分支（multiway branch），其余路径保留原程序；3) 引入代价模型，判定某个经典控制门何时应改写为量子控制门；4) 提供在 Lean 4 中证成可靠性（soundness）的检查器，验证编译后程序与源程序语义一致。
AI.result: 在 QICK 控制器公开的单次决策代价 42 ns 下，65 个程序中有 10 个比代价模型中的最佳基线快至少 10%，最高达 91.2%，主要收益来自用一条多路分支替代长 if 链。在 QubiC 控制器的寄存器传输级逻辑上，编译后的 distance-5 重复码解码器用 21.3 个期望周期完成纠错选择，而未编译版本为 151.1 个期望周期。IBM 真机计时噪声过大，无法证实或否定模型的排序。
AI.conclusion: 反馈等待时间可通过编译层变换有效压缩，且这类变换能够以形式化验证方式保证正确性；多路分支对 syndrome 稀疏的纠错解码器收益最显著。不过其实际硬件收益目前主要在控制器代价模型与 RTL 层面得到确认，真机验证仍受噪声限制，缺乏实证支撑。

title: A Numerical Approach to Quantization
summary: We introduce a numerical approach that simultaneously searches for matrix quantizations and compatible Poisson structures on classical geometric surfaces. Our method identifies irreducible Hermitian matrix representations and a trainable Poisson multiplier by minimizing a loss function that penalizes violations of the Casimir and commutation constraints. Through numerical investigations and subsequent theoretical analysis, we establish a no-go theorem showing that, for Weyl quantized fuzzy spheres with nondegenerate axial spectrum, the matrix dimension cannot exceed the degree of the nonconstant polynomial axial Poisson multiplier. We further extend our approach to nonpolynomial Poisson multipliers, demonstrating its versatility and potential to drive novel discoveries. Although here we focus on Weyl quantized fuzzy spheres, the framework is extensible to general geometric manifolds and quantization schemes. Our approach also provides a practical starting point for investigating Schild string theory and the quantization of spacetime histories.

AI.tldr: 提出一种数值方法，同时搜索经典几何曲面上的矩阵量子化与相容泊松结构；发现Weyl量子化模糊球面的矩阵维数受轴向泊松乘子多项式次数约束的no-go定理。
AI.motivation: 经典几何曲面的量子化通常需要同时确定矩阵表示与相容的泊松结构，而二者的匹配条件（Casimir约束与对易约束）难以解析求解，缺乏统一、可扩展的构造手段。
AI.method: 构造可训练的泊松乘子与不可约Hermitian矩阵表示，通过最小化同时惩罚Casimir约束与对易关系违背的损失函数进行联合数值搜索；随后对所得结果做理论分析，并将框架推广至非多项式泊松乘子。
AI.result: 数值实验结合理论分析给出no-go定理：对具有非退化轴向谱的Weyl量子化模糊球面，矩阵维数不能超过非常数多项式轴向泊松乘子的次数；方法亦可处理非多项式乘子，验证了其通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为矩阵量子化与泊松结构的联合构造提供了可行的数值起点，可推广到一般几何流形与量子化方案，并为Schild弦理论及时空历史量子化的研究提供实践入口。

title: Genuine multipartite entanglement in ring-shaped Hubbard models
summary: Spin states can be extracted from many-electron systems by detecting electrons at a set of lattice sites, which act as particle labels. Here we quantify the genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) of such spin states, which are generally mixed, in standard and extended Hubbard rings, together with the corresponding detection probability. We show that the on-site repulsion, by suppressing charge fluctuations, enhances the GME, and that in the strongly interacting regime at half filling the detection probability decreases only weakly with the number of spins. The GME is robust at temperatures below the singlet--triplet gap, and can even be enhanced by doping, in spite of the induced charge fluctuations. The transition from spin- to charge-density waves in the extended Hubbard model is signaled by an abrupt suppression of both the GME and the detection probability.

AI.tldr: 在标准与扩展Hubbard环中，通过格点探测电子作为粒子标签提取多电子体系自旋态，并量化其（一般混合态）的真实多体纠缠（GME）及探测概率；在位排斥抑制电荷涨落从而增强GME，强关联半满时探测概率随自旋数仅弱下降，GME在单重态-三重态能隙以下温度稳健、并可由掺杂增强，而自旋密度波到电荷密度波的转变表现为GME与探测概率的突降。
AI.motivation: 自旋态可从多电子体系通过格点电子探测（作为粒子标签）中提取，但此类态一般为混合态，其真实多体纠缠的量化和可探测性缺乏系统刻画，尤其在与凝聚态相互作用、填充、温度及相变的关系上尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以标准Hubbard环与扩展Hubbard环为模型，将格点探测得到的（混合）自旋态作为研究对象，计算其真实多体纠缠GME并同时评估相应探测概率；考察在位排斥强度、填充（半满与掺杂）、温度（相对单重态-三重态能隙）以及扩展Hubbard模型中自旋密度波—电荷密度波转变的影响。
AI.result: 在位排斥通过抑制电荷涨落增强GME；强相互作用半满区，探测概率随自旋数目仅弱衰减；GME在低于单重态-三重态能隙的温度下保持稳健，且掺杂虽引入电荷涨落仍可提升GME；扩展Hubbard模型中自旋密度波向电荷密度波转变处，GME与探测概率均出现骤然抑制，可作为相变信号。
AI.conclusion: 格点探测所得混合自旋态的GME在Hubbard类模型中具有较强的鲁棒性，并可通过相互作用、掺杂与温度进行调控；GME及探测概率的突变可作为区分自旋密度波与电荷密度波相的判据，为在多电子体系中提取和利用多体纠缠提供了可行途径。

title: Non-Hermitian edge accretion
summary: Under the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE), it is generally taken for granted that the open boundary condition (OBC) spectrum is encircled by the periodic boundary condition (PBC) spectrum. Intuitively, this is because boundaries tend to block the directed NHSE amplification, thereby suppressing $\operatorname{Im}(E)$. In this work, we analytically and numerically demonstrate how this conventional scenario can be dramatically violated: In a phenomenon which we term non-Hermitian edge accretion (NHEA), strongly coupled competing NHSE channels conspire to amplify a state whenever it bounces off an edge, instead of attenuating it. This unexpected behavior arises from underappreciated consequences of non-Bloch eigenspinor orthogonality, which control the reflection coefficients as well as the balance between propagating and evanescent waves. Operating in the strongly coupled regime, NHEA is fundamentally distinct from conventional critical NHSE scaling, which is characterized by amplification feedback generated in the bulk, not the edges. Requiring only strongly coupled antagonistic NHSE chains with suitable mode orthogonality, the NHEA is platform-agnostic, and can be identified through periodically growing edge bounces in generic non-Hermitian metamaterials and quantum simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并论证了"非厄米边缘增生"(NHEA)现象：在强耦合的竞争性非厄米趋肤效应通道中，边界反射不仅不衰减反而放大状态，从而颠覆"开边界谱被周期边界谱包围"这一惯常认知。
AI.motivation: 长期以来人们普遍认为，开边界条件(OBC)倾向于阻断有向的非厄米趋肤放大，因而OBC谱被周期边界条件(PBC)谱所包围，Im(E)受到抑制。作者质疑这一"理所当然"的直觉，考察其在何种情形下会被根本性违背。
AI.method: 采用解析推导与数值计算相结合的方法，研究强耦合的、方向相互对抗的非厄米趋肤链；通过非布洛赫本征自旋态的（非）正交性分析反射系数以及传播波与倏逝波之间的平衡关系。
AI.result: 发现当两条强耦合的竞争性NHSE通道共存时，状态每次在边界反弹都会被放大而非衰减，导致边缘反弹呈周期性增长；该行为由此前被忽视的非布洛赫本征自旋态正交性所支配。NHEA与常规临界NHSE标度行为有本质区别，后者源于体区而非边界的放大反馈。
AI.conclusion: NHEA仅需强耦合的对抗性NHSE链和适当的模式正交性，具有平台无关性，可在一般非厄米超材料与量子模拟器中通过边缘反弹的周期性增长加以识别。

title: Shallow Clifford circuits on square lattices
summary: We study the depth of CZ circuits, Clifford state preparation, and Clifford unitary synthesis over the two-dimensional square lattice. A programmable circuit on a $2{\times}k$ ladder ($n{=}2k$) implements an arbitrary CZ computation in depth at most $\frac{3n}{2}{+}3$ up to reversal of both rails. This improves the best-known LNN (Linear Nearest-Neighbor)-compliant depth-$(2n{+}2)$ construction by about 25\%. For state preparation, we consider a Phase gate programmable -H-{CNOT+P}-LC- circuit and derive matching obstructions to attaining the CZ-span counting lower bound of $2\lceil\frac{n}{2}\rceil{-}1$ for depth by the entangling gates. For cycle connectivity $C_n$, we prove that the minimum depth is exactly $2\lceil\frac{n}{2}\rceil{-}1$ when $n$ is not a multiple of four and $2\lceil\frac{n}{2}\rceil$ when $n\,{=}\,4k$. We construct a hole-free minimum-perimeter square-lattice patch with a Hamiltonian cycle for every even size, giving optimal-depth programmable circuits to implement Clifford states for all $n\,{=}\,4k{+}2$. Exhaustive and heuristic searches address the remaining cases for $n$ up to 256, and selected values up to 1,024 qubits. The improvement against comparable state-of-the-art, an LNN-compliant depth-$(2n{+}2)$ solution, is about 50\%. Finally, combining state synthesis circuits developed in this work with a known four-diagonal-stage decomposition gives rise to a depth $4n{-}4$ for $n\,{=}\,4k{+}2$ and depth $4n$ for $n\,{=}\,4k$ implementation of arbitrary Clifford unitaries. This improves the most relevant state-of-the-art, an LNN-compliant depth $7n{-}4$ construction, by about 43\%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维方格晶格上 CZ 电路、Clifford 态制备与 Clifford 酉合成的深度：给出 2×k 梯形上深度 3n/2+3 的通用 CZ 电路、环连通下的精确最小深度公式，以及深度 4n−4/4n 的 Clifford 酉合成方案，较现有 LNN 方案分别降低约 50% 与 43%。
AI.motivation: 线性近邻（LNN）约束下的现有构造深度偏高（CZ 为 2n+2、Clifford 酉为 7n−4），而二维晶格、可编程电路等更强连通性与架构下的深度下界与最优构造尚不明确，需要刻画由纠缠门定义的深度下界与可达性。
AI.method: 1) 在 2×k 梯形（n=2k）上构造深度 ≤ 3n/2+3（允许两轨反向）的可编程 CZ 电路；2) 采用 Phase-可编程–H–{CNOT+P}–LC 电路模型，推导相对于 CZ-张成计数下界 2⌈n/2⌉−1 的匹配性障碍；3) 对环连通 C_n 给出深度精确值：n 非 4 的倍数时为 2⌈n/2⌉−1，n=4k 时为 2⌈n/2⌉；4) 对每个偶数尺寸构造含哈密顿回路、无孔洞的最小周长方形晶格补片，从而对 n=4k+2 实现最优深度可编程 Clifford 态制备；5) 对剩余情形用穷举与启发式搜索，覆盖 n≤256 及部分至 1024 量子比特；6) 将态合成电路与已知四对角阶段分解结合，得到任意 Clifford 酉的深度 4n−4（n=4k+2）与 4n（n=4k）。
AI.result: CZ 计算深度由 2n+2 降至 3n/2+3，改进约 25%；态制备相对同类 LNN 深度 2n+2 方案改进约 50%，并在 n=4k+2 时达到计数下界的最优深度；环连通下得到匹配上下界的闭式最小深度；Clifford 酉合成深度 4n−4 / 4n，较深度 7n−4 的 LNN 构造改进约 43%。
AI.conclusion: 在二维方格/梯形架构上，借助可编程电路与哈密顿回路补片，可显著逼近由纠缠门计数给出的深度下界，得到接近最优的 CZ 电路与 Clifford 态/酉合成深度，并明确了环连通及 n mod 4 对最小深度的决定性作用。

title: Reversal of dynamical backaction and cooling below the quantum backaction limit in Floquet-driven multimode optomechanical resonators
comment: 31 pages, 11 figures. Main text: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Supplementary Information: 15 pages, 5 figures. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23734788
summary: Dynamical backaction describes how a driven cavity field responds with delay to mechanical motion, and can be used to cool that motion toward its quantum ground state or amplify it into self-oscillation. Control over this interaction underpins laser cooling, high-fidelity state preparation, quantum transduction, and phonon lasing. In conventional cavity optomechanics, both the sign and the magnitude of the optical damping are dictated by the laser detuning, and cooling is bounded by quantum backaction (QBA), the optomechanical analogue of the Doppler limit in cold atoms. We show, in theory and experiment, that dynamical backaction can be strongly enhanced in multimode optomechanical resonators driven by time-varying (Floquet) optical fields. A modulated drive couples a sideband-unresolved MHz mode to a sideband-resolved GHz mode through the shared cavity, replacing the QBA limit of the target mode by the occupancy of the auxiliary mode. Experimentally, we cool the MHz mode to $47 \pm 13$ phonons, about half its single-mode QBA limit and an order of magnitude below what single-tone backaction reaches at the same intracavity photon number. The character of the interaction can moreover be completely inverted at fixed laser detuning, turning cooling into amplification and vice versa, controlled solely by the modulation frequency. Floquet driving thus extends open-loop quantum control, which requires no measurement or feedback, to mechanical resonators outside the resolved-sideband regime.

AI.tldr: 在由时变（Floquet）光场驱动的多模光机械谐振腔中，动力学反作用可被显著增强：调制驱动通过共享腔将边带未分辨的MHz模式与边带已分辨的GHz模式耦合，用辅助模式的占据数替代目标模式的量子反作用极限；实验将MHz模式冷却至47±13声子，并可在固定失谐下仅靠调制频率反转冷却与放大的符号。
AI.motivation: 传统腔光机械学中，光学阻尼的符号与大小由激光失谐决定，冷却受量子反作用（QBA，冷原子多普勒极限的光机械类比）限制，因而边带未分辨模式难以被有效冷却。作者希望突破这一限制，把无需测量与反馈的开环量子控制扩展到未分辨边带区域的机械谐振器。
AI.method: 理论与实验相结合：采用多模光机械谐振器，施加时间调制（Floquet）驱动，使调制边带通过共享腔把边带未分辨的MHz模式与边带已分辨的GHz辅助模式耦合，从而以辅助模式的占据数取代目标模式的QBA极限；通过改变调制频率调控相互作用性质。
AI.result: 实验将MHz模式冷却至47±13声子，约为其单模QBA极限的一半，比相同腔内光子数下单频驱动所能达到的水平低一个数量级；在固定激光失谐下，仅通过调制频率即可完全反转相互作用性质，使冷却与放大相互转换。
AI.conclusion: Floquet驱动可显著增强动力学反作用，突破单模QBA对未分辨边带模式的冷却限制，并将无测量、无反馈的开环量子控制扩展至分辨边带机制之外的机械谐振器，为激光冷却、高保真态制备、量子转换与声子激光等提供新途径。

title: Proxima: Optimizing Syndrome Extraction Circuit Scheduling for Practical Quantum LDPC Codes
summary: The fault-tolerant performance of quantum error correction codes relies critically on the scheduling of parity checks in syndrome extraction circuits (SECs). For general CSS-type quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes, the vast scheduling space and intricate error-propagation patterns make it computationally prohibitive to directly optimize the logical error rate (LER) or the exact circuit-level distance ($d_{\mathrm{circ}}$). To address this challenge, we introduce Proxima, a highly effective automated SEC scheduling framework guided by a distance-related metric termed proximity. Defined directly on the detector error model (DEM), proximity quantifies the minimum number of additional faults required to complete a seed fault to an undetectable logical failure, naturally capturing arbitrary circuit-level fault mechanisms and bounding $d_{\mathrm{circ}}$ from above. Proxima synthesizes a pool of valid schedules at a target depth and ranks them by evaluating proximity within small, graph-local DEM fault subsets, progressively enlarging the subset only to break ties among top-ranked candidates. Across a broad spectrum of qLDPC code families, Proxima consistently attains low circuit depths and high circuit-level distance bounds, reducing LER by 1.4--2.6$\times$ over the strongest automated baseline and up to $40\times$ over others while generalizing robustly across noise models and decoders. Furthermore, by exploiting translational symmetry via a compact monomial representation, Proxima discovers depth-8 uniform schedules for bivariate bicycle codes that surpass even IBM's depth-7 reference schedule [Nature, 2024] by 2.1--5.1$\times$, establishing the DEM-level proximity as a practical objective for fault-tolerant compilation.

AI.tldr: 提出Proxima——基于探测器错误模型(DEM)邻近度指标的自动化 syndrome extraction circuit 调度框架,在qLDPC码上以低深度获得高电路级距离界,显著降低逻辑错误率。
AI.motivation: CSS型qLDPC码的校验调度空间巨大、错误传播模式复杂,直接优化LER或精确电路级距离d_circ计算上不可行,需要可计算且与距离相关的替代目标。
AI.method: 定义直接在DEM上的"proximity"指标:量化将种子故障补全为不可检测逻辑失败所需的最少附加故障数,可上界d_circ并捕获任意电路级故障机制;在目标深度下合成有效调度池,通过图局部小DEM故障子集上的proximity排序,仅在打破并列时逐步扩大子集;利用平移对称性的紧凑单项式表示搜索双变量自行车码的均匀调度。
AI.result: 在多类qLDPC码上取得低电路深度与高电路级距离界,LER较最强自动化基线降低1.4–2.6倍、较其他基线最高40倍,并在不同噪声模型与解码器下稳健泛化;对双变量自行车码发现深度8均匀调度,较IBM深度7参考调度[Nature, 2024]优2.1–5.1倍。
AI.conclusion: DEM级proximity可作为容错编译的实用优化目标。

title: Fixed Points as Programs: Finite Symmetry and One-Shot State-Gate Duality in the Misty-State Calculus
summary: The same quantum object can support several logically distinct descriptions: it can be an eigenstate of an operator, a fixed point of an action, a nonstabilizer resource, or a state consumed by a gate-injection protocol. We make these relations precise in the misty-state calculus. The semantic core is a normalized superposition constructor $x\star y=\operatorname{N}(x+y)$. For any finite unitary group $G$, whenever the orbit sum is nonzero, the normalized orbit cloud $\operatorname{N}(\sum_{g\in G}U_gx)$ is fixed by every element of $G$; the involutive specialization $x\star Ux$ is therefore a certified fixed-point constructor. Applied to $U=H$ and $x=|0\rangle$, it gives the nested misty state $M=\operatorname{N}\{W,\operatorname{N}\{W,B\}\}$, the $+1$ Hadamard eigenstate. This state is not a Pauli stabilizer state; it is an H-type magic state and is Clifford-equivalent to $T|+\rangle$. We then prove an exact one-shot state-gate duality. Writing $J=XZ$ and $R_θ=e^{θJ}$, the state $M_θ=R_θ|0\rangle$ can be consumed by a Clifford controlled-$J$ injection circuit to apply either $R_θ$ or $R_θ^{-1}$ to arbitrary data. Whenever $R_θ^2$ is free, feed-forward makes the implementation deterministic. At $θ=π/8$, $R_θ^2=HZ=XH$ is Clifford, so one copy of $M$ implements one exact use of the non-Clifford gate $R=e^{πJ/8}$; conversely one use of $R$ prepares $M$ from $|0\rangle$. We formulate this as a pair of sound semantic certificates, $\operatorname{Fix}(U)$ and $\operatorname{Prog}(R)$, and separate the resulting finite symmetrization mechanism from the genuinely recursive fixed-point role of the $Y$ combinator, while identifying the exact $S$-combinator sharing pattern in $x\star Ux$. The result is a small, auditable semantics in which invariance and consumable program resources coexist without being conflated.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"迷雾态演算"（misty-state calculus），以归一化叠加构造子 x⋆y=N(x+y) 为语义核心，统一刻画量子对象的不动点描述与可消耗资源描述，并证明精确的一次性态-门对偶。
AI.motivation: 同一量子对象常被赋予多种逻辑上不同的描述：算符本征态、群作用的不动点、非稳定子资源、门注入协议消耗的态。这些关系此前缺乏统一、可审计的形式语义，且"不动点"与"可消耗程序资源"两种身份易被混为一谈。
AI.method: 引入归一化叠加构造子 x⋆y=N(x+y)；对任意有限酉群 G，证明非零轨道和的归一化轨道云 N(Σ_{g∈G}U_g x) 被 G 中每个元素固定，故 x⋆Ux 是对合情形下的"认证不动点构造子"。取 U=H、x=|0⟩ 得到嵌套迷雾态 M（+1 Hadamard 本征态）。进而给出一次性态-门对偶：令 J=XZ、R_θ=e^{θJ}，用 Clifford 受控-J 注入电路消耗 M_θ=R_θ|0⟩ 以施加 R_θ 或其逆；当 R_θ² 为自由门时借助前馈使实现确定化。以 Fix(U) 与 Prog(R) 两类语义证书形式化，并将有限对称化机制与 Y 组合子的递归不动点角色区分开，同时识别 x⋆Ux 中精确的 S 组合子共享模式。
AI.result: M=N{W,N{W,B}} 是 H 型魔法态，非 Pauli 稳定子态，且与 T|+⟩ Clifford 等价。θ=π/8 时 R_θ²=HZ=XH 为 Clifford，故单个 M 精确实现一次非 Clifford 门 R=e^{πJ/8}，反之一次 R 可从 |0⟩ 制备 M，构成精确一次性对偶。Fix(U) 与 Prog(R) 均为可靠的语义证书。
AI.conclusion: 得到一个小型、可审计的语义框架，使不变性与可消耗程序资源得以共存而不被混淆。

title: The Cost of Quantum State Conversion
summary: Which losses in quantum-state preparation can better control remove, and which are imposed by the available resources? We determine the least entropy production for converting known full-rank states using fresh thermal auxiliaries of fixed size and bounded energy range, with arbitrary driven joint control. For every reachable target, the asymptotic infimum is the decrease of a computable function of the state's spectrum. Explicit finite protocols approach this limit, including at saturated resource constraints. The result therefore supplies an attainable benchmark for state preparation, rather than only a lower bound. Reusable memory changes both reachability and the cost without enlarging any fresh auxiliary. A uniform memory gives an exact rescaling of the resource parameter; all memory states preparable from it under the same constraint have the same reachable targets and asymptotic costs. Externally supplied biased memories can do better, revealing a preparation resource distinct from dimension. With sufficient fixed memory, protocols reach exact product endpoints while dissipation decreases inversely with operation count. These results connect algorithmic cooling, quantum resource theories, and constructive control by separating unavoidable loss from the overhead of a chosen implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在固定尺寸、有限能量范围的全新热辅助比特与任意驱动联合控制下，将已知满秩量子态转换所需的最小熵产生，给出可达的渐近下确界与显式有限协议，并区分不可避免的耗散与实现开销。
AI.motivation: 量子态制备中哪些损耗可通过更好的控制消除、哪些由可用资源（辅助比特尺寸、能量范围）所强加，此前缺乏明确的定量划分；已有结果多只给出下界而缺少可达基准。
AI.method: 设定资源模型：新鲜热辅助态尺寸固定、能量范围有界，允许任意驱动的联合控制；对可达到的目标态，推导最小熵产生的渐近下确界，该值可写为态谱的某个可计算函数的减小量；构造显式有限步协议逼近该极限，并考察可复用记忆对可达性与成本的影响，包括均匀记忆与外部提供的偏置记忆。
AI.result: 对每个可达目标，渐近下确界等于某个谱函数的减少量，且显式有限协议可逼近它，在资源约束饱和时亦然；均匀记忆仅对资源参数给出精确的重标定，由其所可制备的所有记忆态具有相同的可达目标与渐近成本；外部偏置记忆可取得更低成本，揭示出一种不同于维度的制备资源；足够固定记忆下协议可精确到达乘积端点，且耗散随操作次数反比下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果为态制备提供了可达到的基准而非仅下界，将不可避免耗散与实现方案开销分离，从而联系起算法冷却、量子资源理论与构造性控制。

title: Quantum Loading of Charge and Spin-Adapted MPS
summary: Matrix product states (MPS) are powerful classical representations of correlated quantum states, but loading a large bond dimension MPS can substantially increase the cost in fault-tolerant quantum algorithms. We develop a circuit for preparing a U(1)~$\times$~SU(2)-symmetric MPS directly from spin-adapted reduced tensors. Using Householder--LKS synthesis, the circuit prepares each symmetry-allowed reduced block and applies Clebsch--Gordan coefficients to recover the magnetic degrees of freedom, avoiding explicit loading of the corresponding unfolded dense tensors. The reduced-tensor data loading is dominant in cost. We benchmark $4 \times 4$ and $4 \times 6$ Fermi--Hubbard states and active-space models of \ce{[Fe2S2]^2-}, \ce{[Fe4S4]^2-}, and low- and high-spin cytochrome P450. At 15-bit rotation precision, the molecular benchmarks show $\sim 14\times$ to $54\times$ Toffoli reductions, $\sim 20\times$ to $87\times$ active volume reduction, and $\sim 33\times$ to $140\times$ volume (Toffoli $\times$ qubits) reduction at the QROM-optimal point, relative to dense MPS loading. Fermi--Hubbard speedups increase with bond dimension and track the inverse tensor density, with modest qubit overhead. However, while we discuss generalization of our algorithm to reduce cost given further symmetry or using more performant unitary synthesis methods, extrapolation to larger lattices suggests that DMRG-state loading may exceed downstream phase-estimation costs, motivating co-design of state fidelity, compression, and the initial-state ansatz.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从自旋适配的约化张量直接制备 U(1)×SU(2) 对称 MPS 的量子线路，避免加载稠密展开张量，在分子与 Hubbard 基准上实现显著 Toffoli/体积缩减。
AI.motivation: 大键维 MPS 在容错量子算法中的加载成本很高，稠密展开张量加载代价随维度迅速膨胀，需利用对称性压缩加载数据量。
AI.method: 利用 U(1)×SU(2) 对称性，基于 Householder–LKS 酉合成逐块制备对称允许的约化块，再用 Clebsch–Gordan 系数恢复磁量子数自由度，从而不显式加载展开的稠密张量；成本由约化张量数据加载主导。
AI.result: 在 4×4、4×6 Fermi–Hubbard 态及 [Fe2S2]^2-、[Fe4S4]^2-、高低自旋细胞色素 P450 活性空间模型上，15 位旋转精度下相对稠密 MPS 加载实现约 14×–54× Toffoli 缩减、20×–87× 活动体积缩减、33×–140× 体积（Toffoli×量子比特）缩减（QROM 最优点）；Hubbard 加速随键维增长并随张量密度反向变化，量子比特开销适中。
AI.conclusion: 方法可推广至更多对称性或更强酉合成以进一步降本；但外推至大晶格表明 DMRG 态加载可能超过后续相位估计成本，故需对态保真度、压缩与初态拟设进行协同设计。

title: Quantum state texture from the average absolutes of density entries
summary: Quantum state texture is recently recognized as an important quantum resource in quantum information tasks. The only textureless state firstly proposed in $(Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 260801 (2024))$ is $f_1=\ket{f_1}\bra{f_1}$, \textcolor{red}{where $\ket{f_1}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{d}}\sum_{i=1}^{d}\ket{i}$.} We take into account the modulus of the density matrix entries, and reasonably define the textureless states to be ones that all the modulus of the density matrix entries are equal. We present a quantifier of quantum state texture with respect to such non-convexity set of textureless states. As an application, we demonstrate in the transverse field Ising model that the texture of the subsystem of the ground state effectively characterize the quantum phase transitions, providing an alternative texture-based characterization of quantum criticality. We also provide the relationships among the quantum state texture, coherence and purity. Furthermore, we explore the quantum state texture based quantum speed limit in dissipative dynamical processes and derive the lower bound on the time required in texture variation for some dynamical processes.

AI.tldr: 该文基于密度矩阵元素模值全等的条件重新定义了非凸的"无纹理态"集合，提出量子态纹理的量化方法，并展示其在量子相变刻画、与相干性/纯度的关系以及耗散动力学中量子速度极限的应用。
AI.motivation: 已有工作(PRL 133, 260801 (2024))仅给出唯一无纹理态 f1=|f1⟩⟨f1|，无纹理态集合过于局限；作者认为应基于密度矩阵元素模值刻画纹理，需要更一般化的无纹理态定义与相应量化工具。
AI.method: 取密度矩阵各元素模值，定义"所有矩阵元模值相等"的态为无纹理态，构成非凸集；据此定义量子态纹理的量化子；在横场Ising模型中用基态子系统的纹理刻画量子相变；推导纹理与相干性、纯度的关系；构建纹理型量子速度极限并给出耗散过程中纹理变化所需时间的下界。
AI.result: 纹理量化子可在横场Ising模型中有效表征量子相变，提供基于纹理的临界性刻画；给出纹理与相干性、纯度间的解析关系；导出耗散动力学中纹理变化时间的下界。
AI.conclusion: 将无纹理态由单点推广到矩阵元模值相等的非凸集合，使量子态纹理的量化更自然普适；纹理作为量子资源可刻画临界性与动力学速度极限，并与相干性、纯度建立联系。

title: No complete set of mutually unbiased bases in C^6 without Fourier vanishing
summary: A recent exact certificate shows that C^6 admits no seven mutually unbiased bases, hence at most five (OpenAI, 2026). That argument has two parts. The first proves the Fourier-vanishing conjecture of Matolcsi, Ruzsa and Weiner for every complex Hadamard matrix of order six other than Tao's cubic matrix, and excludes the cubic matrix separately. The second feeds this vanishing into a positivity certificate on mixed moments of a hypothetical complete family. We show that the first part is not needed. We keep the same six families of test functions and the same linear identities, but we never set a moment to zero because of Fourier vanishing. New positive definite integer matrices still give the contradiction. The only inputs are orthonormality, unbiasedness, the second-moment (2-design) identity of a complete family, and the trivial bound |moment| <= 1. A standard-library program checks the certificate in exact integer and rational arithmetic in under a minute and a half. We also record computational observations that are not part of the proof: a systematic S_6-symmetric family of test functions appears to close the argument with relations of total order at most 7 instead of 11, and at order 9 two orbit types of test charges appear to suffice. In the prime-power dimensions 4,5,7,8, where complete families exist, the same pipeline finds no certificate, as it must.

AI.tldr: 简化 C^6 不存在七元互不偏基的既有证明：抛弃傅里叶消失猜想部分，仅用正交归一、无偏性、二阶矩恒等式与 |moment|≤1，以新的正定整数矩阵在精确有理运算下重现矛盾。
AI.motivation: 先前精确证明显示 C^6 至多有五个互不偏基，但其第一部分需逐类证明 Matolcsi–Ruzsa–Weiner 傅里叶消失猜想（并对 Tao 三次矩阵单独排除），代价高且依赖较强的傅里叶分析输入。作者希望去掉这一依赖，降低证明的技术门槛。
AI.method: 保留原有的六族测试函数与同一组线性恒等式，但不再利用傅里叶消失将矩置零；改用新的正定整数矩阵构造正性证书，得到矛盾。可用的输入仅为：基的正交归一性、无偏性、完全族的二阶矩（2-design）恒等式，以及平凡界 |moment| ≤ 1。证书由标准库程序在精确整数与有理算术下验证。
AI.result: 新证书无需傅里叶消失即产生矛盾，程序在约 90 秒内完成精确算术验证。附带计算观察（非证明的一部分）：一个系统化的 S_6 对称测试函数族似可将关系总阶数从 11 降至不超过 7；阶数为 9 时两类轨道型测试电荷即可充分。在存在完全族的素数幂维 4、5、7、8 中，同一流程按预期找不到证书。
AI.conclusion: C^6 不存在七个互不偏基这一结论的证明可简化为初等的矩不等式 + 正定整数矩阵证书，不再依赖傅里叶消失猜想的分类论证；同时给出若干可进一步压缩证书规模的对称性观察。

title: Efficient numerical measurement design and certified risk bounds for multiparameter quantum estimation
summary: Multiparameter quantum estimation requires efficient measurement design and reliable bounds on the attainable precision. We present Q-StARC, a numerical framework that combines measurement optimization with certified lower bounds on the weighted variance of locally unbiased estimators. The measurement search parameterizes rank-one measurements on a complex Stiefel manifold and combines projected ambient Adam updates, QR retraction, and Riemannian conjugate-gradient refinement. Independent risk bounds are obtained from a denominator-based matrix sum-of-squares hierarchy. When its support coefficients are optimized jointly, the hierarchy starts at the weighted Nagaoka-Hayashi (NH) bound and converges to the optimal locally unbiased risk, including for singular states. Numerical applications certify that the NH bound is unattainable for several finite-copy qubit models and two full eight-parameter qutrit models. For the qutrit examples, the certified relative gaps above the NH bound exceed $14\%$ and $11\%$, while the level-$m=1$ lower bounds agree with the best numerical measurement costs to relative differences of $4.5\times10^{-7}$ and $2.2\times10^{-6}$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-StARC数值框架，将秩一测量优化与可认证的加权方差下界结合，用于多参数量子估计，并给出NH界不可达的严格证书。
AI.motivation: 多参数量子估计既需要高效的测量设计，也需要对可达精度给出可靠（可认证）的界；现有加权Nagaoka-Hayashi（NH）界是否可达缺乏系统性判据，且数值下界往往缺少严格保证。
AI.method: Q-StARC由两部分组成：(1) 测量搜索：在复Stiefel流形上参数化秩一测量，采用投影环境Adam更新、QR回缩与黎曼共轭梯度精修；(2) 下界：基于分母的矩阵平方和（SOS）层级给出独立的局部无偏估计风险下界，联合优化其支撑系数时，该层级从加权NH界出发并收敛到最优局部无偏风险，对奇异态亦适用。
AI.result: 数值上证明NH界在若干有限拷贝量子比特模型与两个完整八参数qutrit模型中不可达；qutrit例中高于NH界的可认证相对间隙分别超过14%与11%，而m=1级下界与最佳数值测量代价的相对差分别为4.5×10⁻⁷和2.2×10⁻⁶。
AI.conclusion: 测量优化与SOS下界相互印证，形成可认证的估计精度评估流程；结果表明NH界并非普遍可达，而低层级SOS界在实际模型中已能紧致逼近最优局部无偏风险。

title: Quantum state tomography with measurement-conditioned diffusion models
summary: We introduce Diff-QST, a measurement-conditioned diffusion model for quantum state tomography that learns from an ensemble of input states and reconstructs a physical density operator from noisy, possibly incomplete Pauli measurements in two or three denoising steps. In simulations of two to five qubits, Diff-QST has higher mean fidelity than maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE) and a semidefinite-programming least-squares estimator (SDP) in all 120 tested conditions at nominal noise. After training, GPU reconstruction is faster than both in condition-averaged time at every system size and, at four and five qubits, in every condition. At four and five qubits, though not at two and three, Diff-QST also has higher fidelity than an architecture-matched regression baseline trained without diffusion. At five qubits, over the tested numbers of observables and shots per observable, it reaches a specified fidelity with 25%-67% fewer total shots than this baseline. Under state and noise distributions that differ from those used in training, Diff-QST retains its fidelity advantage over MLE and SDP in most tested conditions, although it can reverse. Diff-QST is therefore suited to fast tomography from noisy, incomplete Pauli measurements of states represented by its training ensemble.

AI.tldr: Diff-QST：以测量为条件的扩散模型做量子态层析，2-3步去噪从含噪、可能不完整的Pauli测量重构密度算符；保真度与速度总体优于MLE和SDP。
AI.motivation: 传统重构器（MLE、SDP最小二乘）在含噪、测量不完备条件下精度受限且计算开销大，尤其在多比特系统上难以兼顾质量与速度。
AI.method: 提出测量条件化的扩散模型Diff-QST，从输入态集合中学习先验，仅用2至3个去噪步即可从含噪、可能不完整的Pauli测量数据重构物理密度算符；并与MLE、SDP估计器及架构匹配的无扩散回归基线对比。
AI.result: 在2-5比特仿真中，标称噪声下120种测试条件的平均保真度全部高于MLE与SDP；GPU重构在每种系统规模的平均耗时上均更快，4-5比特时在每一条件上均更快；4-5比特保真度高于同架构回归基线；5比特下达到指定保真度所需总测量次数比该基线少25%-67%；在偏离训练的态与噪声分布下多数条件仍保持优势，但优势可能反转。
AI.conclusion: Diff-QST适用于针对其训练集合所代表状态的、快速且高质量含噪不完备Pauli测量层析；其优势依赖于训练分布，分布偏移下性能可能退化。

title: Record-proof optical communication enabled by a quantum receiver with lossless optical decryption
summary: We propose record-proof physical-layer encryption (PLE) based on quantum-optimal reception. Unlike conventional symmetric-key encryption algorithms, the proposed scheme prevents decryption of recorded signals even if the secret key is disclosed after transmission. Existing PLE schemes rely on practical limitations of the eavesdropper's receiver in pursuing record-proof security; ours instead exploits the noncommutativity of conjugate optical quadratures to give the legitimate receiver an intrinsic sensitivity advantage. A phase-controlled Kennedy receiver performs lossless optical decryption and near-optimal binary-state discrimination. We demonstrate record-proof security with a 3.0-dB channel-loss budget, showing that quantum receivers offer cryptographic functions beyond sensitivity enhancement.

AI.tldr: 提出基于量子最优接收的"记录证明"物理层加密（PLE）方案，利用共轭光正交分量的非对易性，使合法接收机获得本源灵敏度优势；相位控制Kennedy接收机实现无损光域解密与近最优二态判别，在3.0 dB信道损耗预算下达成记录证明安全性。
AI.motivation: 传统对称密钥加密在密钥于传输后泄露时，窃听者可解密其先前录制的信号。既有PLE方案依赖窃听者接收机的实际硬件限制来追求"记录证明"安全性，理论基础不牢靠，因此需要一种基于物理原理（而非设备局限）的固有安全机制。
AI.method: 利用量子力学中共轭光正交分量（如相位与振幅）的非对易性，为合法接收方构建内在的探测灵敏度优势；采用相位控制的Kennedy接收机，在光域完成无损解密，并实现接近量子极限的二进制态判别。
AI.result: 在3.0 dB的信道损耗预算下，实验/方案层面验证了记录证明安全性，即密钥事后公开亦无法使窃听者解密已录制的信号。
AI.conclusion: 量子接收机不仅能提升灵敏度，还具备超出灵敏度增强范畴的密码学功能，为物理层安全提供了不依赖设备缺陷的新范式。

title: Bowed-String-Mechanism-Inspired Quantum Dissociation Control of Molecules
summary: Inspired by Guettler's mechanics of accelerating Helmholtz motion, we present a predictive laser pulse-shaping strategy to rapidly initiate the multiphoton dissociation of vibrationally excited diatomic molecules. In intense infrared fields, NO molecules often exhibit unpredictable control windows due to the chaotic fragmentation of intensity thresholds. By incorporating a bowing-analogue transient shaper enforced by a boundary-matching constraint with symmetric derivative slope transitions and vanishing initial boundary conditions ($T(0) = 0, T'(0) = 0$), we demonstrate that a pulse engineered with non-linear front-flank acceleration reduces the multi-valued threshold topology into a single, predictable linear dissociation corridor. Wigner quasiprobability distributions confirm that this temporal acceleration trajectory opens cantori bottlenecks and suppresses wave-packet fragmentation, restricting the quantum non-classicality index to $M_{\text{nc}} \le 0.15$. Our simulations verify that this trajectory engineering preserves wave-packet localization and maintains high dissociation yields ($P_{\text{diss}} > 0.95$) even under Markovian thermal dephasing ($δ/ω_0 = 10^{-4}$) and frozen rotational variations up to $J = 5$. Comparison with contemporary ultrafast spectral phase modulation protocols demonstrates that conventional smooth pulse envelopes, despite advanced phase-chirping, exhibit limitations in restricting non-hyperbolic cantori stickiness due to insufficient sub-picosecond acceleration. In contrast, our boundary-constrained shaper enforces a deterministic, single-valued dissociation corridor under equivalent few-picosecond control windows.

AI.tldr: 借鉴Guettler加速Helmholtz运动的力学思想，提出一种边界约束型激光脉冲整形策略，通过非线性前沿加速将阈值多值拓扑压缩为单一线性解离通道，实现振动激发双原子分子（NO）快速多光子解离。
AI.motivation: 强红外场中NO分子因强度阈值的混沌碎裂而呈现不可预测的控制窗口，传统平滑脉冲包络即便配合相位啁啾也难以抑制非双曲cantori粘滞，缺乏亚皮秒尺度加速能力。
AI.method: 构造类比"弓形"瞬态整形器，施加边界匹配约束（T(0)=0, T'(0)=0，对称导数斜率过渡），设计具有非线性前沿加速的脉冲；用Wigner准概率分布分析波包演化与cantori瓶颈，并在马尔可夫热退相干（δ/ω0=10⁻⁴）及J≤5冻结转动态下做数值模拟，与超快谱相位调制方案对比。
AI.result: 多值阈值拓扑被压缩为单一可预测的线性解离走廊；Wigner分布显示该加速轨迹打开cantori瓶颈、抑制波包碎裂，量子非经典性指数限制在M_nc≤0.15；解离产率保持P_diss>0.95。对比显示常规平滑包络受限于cantori粘滞。
AI.conclusion: 边界约束整形器可在数皮秒控制窗口内建立确定性、单值化解离走廊，兼顾波包局域化与高产率，优于传统谱相位调制协议。

title: Deterministic preparation of squeezed Schrödinger cat states with arbitrary size and squeezing
summary: We introduce a scheme for the deterministic preparation of squeezed Schrödinger cat states based on reservoir engineering. Our proposal relies on the linear and quadratic coupling of an oscillator mode to an auxiliary mode that decays into a vacuum reservoir. For suitable couplings, we show that the system unconditionally relaxes into a pure steady state. We derive an analytical expression for the steady state in terms of the coupling constants, and show that it corresponds to a displaced and squeezed finite superposition of Fock states. Numerical simulations further confirms that this state is reached with unit fidelity from a thermal initial state, without measurement, feedback or post-selection. Additionally, we derive analytical expressions for the non-Gaussianity and the Wigner function of the steady state. Our results reveal that states exhibiting maximal non-Gaussianity are excellent approximations of squeezed Schrödinger cat states, with fidelities exceeding $0.996$. The optimal squeezing stays close to 3dB, while the squared cat size scales proportionally with the highest Fock state occupation number in the finite superposition of the steady state. These maximally non-Gaussian states also maximise the Wigner logarithmic negativity. Finally, by selecting the appropriate ratios of the couplings, our scheme can generate cat states subject to arbitrary squeezing and displacement.

AI.tldr: 基于库工程（reservoir engineering），通过振子模式与耗散到真空库的辅助模式的线性与二次耦合，系统无条件下弛豫到纯稳态，该稳态为压缩、位移的有限Fock态叠加，可高保真近似压缩薛定谔猫态。
AI.motivation: 确定性制备压缩薛定谔猫态通常依赖测量、反馈或后选择，本文旨在提出无需这些手段的无条件确定性方案。
AI.method: 采用库工程方案：振子模式与辅助模式同时存在线性耦合与二次耦合，辅助模式耗散至真空库；求解系统纯稳态的解析表达式（以耦合常数表示），并通过数值模拟从热初态出发验证收敛性；推导稳态的非高斯性与Wigner函数解析式。
AI.result: 系统无条件下弛豫到纯稳态，对应位移且压缩的有限Fock态叠加；从热初态模拟以单位保真度达到该态，无需测量、反馈或后选择；最大非高斯态对压缩猫态保真度超0.996，最优压缩接近3 dB，猫态尺寸平方与最大Fock占据数成比例，并同时最大化Wigner对数负性。
AI.conclusion: 该库工程方案可确定性、无测量地制备压缩薛定谔猫态；通过调节耦合比可生成任意压缩与位移的猫态，为量子非高斯态制备提供可行途径。

title: Quantum teleportation with photons from remote quantum dots emitting at telecom C-band
summary: Employing quantum teleportation to increase the communication distance in quantum channels requires distinct quantum light sources, preferably operating at telecommunication wavelength. Here we utilize two semiconductor In(Ga)As quantum dots, strain engineered to emit in the telecom C-band, as sources of single- and entangled-photons, respectively. This enables a full-photonic quantum teleportation experiment, achieving a maximum teleportation fidelity of 92.7(5)%. Owing to state-of-the-art source brightness, and high time resolution, it is here possible to employ the three-photon coincidences to fully quantify the time-dependence of the process. In this way, we highlight current limitations and implement an optimization in the data-processing which leads to the maximization of achievable teleportation fidelity and coincidence rates. These results constitute a step forward in practical implementations of quantum teleportation in future fiber-based quantum networks.

AI.tldr: 利用两颗应变工程、发射于电信C波段的In(Ga)As半导体量子点分别作为单光子源与纠缠光子源，实现全光子量子隐形传态，最大保真度92.7(5)%；并借助高亮度源与高时间分辨，用三光子符合测量完整刻画过程的随时间演化，优化数据处理以最大化保真度与符合率。
AI.motivation: 量子隐形传态可延长量子信道通信距离，但实际应用需要适配光纤网络、最好工作在电信波长的专用量子光源，现有实现在这方面的光源与表征精度仍受限。
AI.method: 采用两颗经应变工程调谐至电信C波段的In(Ga)As半导体量子点，分别提供单光子与纠缠光子，构建全光子隐形传态装置；利用高亮度光源与高时间分辨实现三光子符合测量，定量给出传态过程的时域依赖，并据此在数据处理层面进行优化。
AI.result: 实现最大隐形传态保真度92.7(5)%；通过三光子符合测量完整量化过程的时域行为，揭示当前限制因素，并经数据处理优化使可达传态保真度与符合计数率同时最大化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了基于电信波段量子点光源的高保真量子隐形传态及其时域精细表征与优化方法，为光纤量子网络中隐形传态的实际部署迈进一步。

title: Pulse-timing errors in exchange-only spin qubits: how one control imperfection propagates to VQE, QAOA and fault-tolerance primitives
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables; code and data at https://github.com/minatoyuichiro/eotime
summary: In an exchange-only (EO) spin qubit every gate is a sequence of Heisenberg exchange pulses whose only continuous parameter is the pulse area. We ask how an error in that area propagates to an algorithm's result. On up to six encoded qubits we compile VQE for H$_2$ and LiH, QAOA MaxCut, Grover search, phase estimation and a distance-3 repetition code into exchange pulses and perturb every pulse with a systematic fractional error $\varepsilon$, an offset or per-pulse jitter. For circuits whose first-order response is negligible at the threshold, the useful regime ends at $\varepsilon$ of a few $10^{-3}$: chemical accuracy is lost at $\approx6\times10^{-3}$ for both molecules and 5% of success probability between 3 and $9\times10^{-3}$ for 498-1216 pulses. A systematic error accumulates as the square of the depth and biases the answer; jitter accumulates linearly and, within statistics, does not bias phase estimation. Leakage from inter-block pulses is a third of the CNOT error, survives variational re-optimisation and a leakage-controlled entangler, and makes a leakage-blind repetition-code round worse than its uncorrected data by a factor 38-93 at $\varepsilon=10^{-2}$ in three of four compilations; in the fourth the uncorrected data already fail. The compilation moves the thresholds by a factor of two to eight. Measured over-rotation and exchange noise put devices at the edge of this regime, and with the measured 3.5 $μ$s $T_2^*$ a quasi-static magnetic gradient limits thousand-pulse circuits unless $J/h$ reaches several hundred MHz with continuous areas, because a duration grid of 2-5% of the SWAP time starts to cost chemical accuracy. As a bit budget, a common-mode area error needs 8-10 significant bits and a 6-bit significand for the durations suffices in the tested circuits; half-precision words and picosecond timers exceed this; older devices had 6-8 bits of analog stability.

AI.tldr: 本文将VQE、QAOA、Grover、相位估计与距离3重复码编译为纯交换（EO）自旋量子比特脉冲序列，系统研究脉冲面积误差的传播规律并给出精度预算。
AI.motivation: EO自旋量子比特中唯一的连续控制参数是交换脉冲面积，但其误差如何传播到算法结果缺乏定量刻画，需要明确“有用工作区”的误差阈与器件比特预算。
AI.method: 在至多6个编码比特上把H2与LiH的VQE、MaxCut的QAOA、Grover搜索、相位估计和距离3重复码编译为Heisenberg交换脉冲序列；对每个脉冲施加系统性分数误差ε、固定偏移或逐脉冲抖动，并考察不同编译方案、变分再优化与漏控纠缠门的影响。
AI.result: 一阶响应可忽略的电路中，有用区间止于ε约10^-3量级：两分子在ε≈6×10^-3失去化学精度，498–1216个脉冲下成功率5%阈值为3–9×10^-3；系统误差按深度平方累积并偏置结果，抖动线性累积且基本不偏置相位估计；块间脉冲泄漏约为CNOT误差的1/3，存活变分再优化与漏控门，在ε=10^-2时使漏盲重复码一轮在四分之三编译中劣于未纠数据38–93倍；编译方案可移动阈值2–8倍。
AI.conclusion: 实测过旋转与交换噪声使器件处于该区间边缘；T2*=3.5 μs下准静态梯度限制千脉冲电路除非J/h达数百MHz且面积连续（2–5% SWAP时间的时间格点即损失化学精度）；共模面积误差需8–10有效位、6位有效数字的持续时间字足够，半精度与皮秒计时器过剩，旧器件模拟稳定性仅6–8位。

title: Efficient AOD-Transport Compilation for Neutral-Atom Arrays
summary: Neutral-atom quantum computers execute two-qubit gates by shuttling atoms between storage and entanglement zones with acousto-optic deflectors (AODs). The efficiency of these movements determines circuit fidelity via transport overhead, idle-atom crosstalk, and atom-transfer errors. Additionally, AOD hardware constraints limit parallel atom movements, so efficient qubit placement and routing are essential. We present NEAT (Neutral-atom Efficient AOD-Transport compiler). Its transport-informed placement evaluates each decision by its incremental equivalent time, a single cost combining transport time, atom-transfer loss, and crosstalk. Its partial-progress routing allows conflicting moves to advance concurrently via intermediate waypoints. NEAT also schedules gates to maximize parallelism and uses a staggered atom array whose trap geometry preemptively avoids AOD violations without extra moves. On standard benchmark circuits, NEAT outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) compilers in fidelity, circuit duration, and compilation time. On scalability benchmarks of up to 1,000 qubits, it shortens circuits by 1.9x, reduces the negative log-fidelity by 1.5x, and compiles 6.6x faster than SOTA compilers on average. Overall, NEAT is a lightweight yet effective compiler for efficient and scalable neutral-atom quantum computing. The code is available at https://github.com/HaydnCheng77/NEAT.

AI.tldr: NEAT：面向中性原子量子计算的AOD传输感知编译器，通过增量等效时间统一建模传输时间、转移损失与串扰，并采用部分进展路由与错位阵列，在保真度、电路时长和编译时间上全面超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 中性原子量子计算机依赖AOD在存储区与纠缠区之间搬运原子来实现两比特门，搬运效率通过传输开销、空闲原子串扰和原子转移误差直接决定电路保真度；同时AOD硬件约束限制了并行搬运能力，因此需要高效且传输感知的量子比特放置与路由。
AI.method: 提出NEAT编译器，包含四方面技术：(1) 传输感知的布局，以"增量等效时间"这一单一代价统一刻画传输时间、原子转移损失与串扰来评估每个决策；(2) 部分进展路由，允许冲突的移动通过中间路点并发推进；(3) 门调度以最大化并行度；(4) 采用错位原子阵列，利用陷阱几何预先规避AOD违规而无需额外移动。
AI.result: 在标准基准电路上，NEAT在保真度、电路时长和编译时间三方面均优于SOTA编译器；在最多1000量子比特的可扩展性基准上，平均电路时长缩短1.9倍，负对数保真度降低1.5倍，编译速度提升6.6倍。
AI.conclusion: NEAT是一种轻量且有效的编译器，可支撑高效、可扩展的中性原子量子计算，代码已开源。

title: Hardware-Aware Realization of Deterministic Quantum-Walk Search on Complete Bipartite Graphs
summary: Complete bipartite graphs offer a canonical platform for deterministic quantum search with quadratic speedup. We report the first experimental realization of deterministic discrete-time quantum-walk search over complete bipartite graphs, enabled by high-fidelity operations and a dynamical-phase compensation scheme, using a digital gate-based processor rather than an evolution-based platform. By compiling the search circuits to the native gate set and square-lattice topology, we implement full-space encoding to realize instances of graph sizes $N = 4$ and $8$, with success probabilities of 97.6% and 70.8% for finding the marked vertex, respectively. We also realize resource-efficient exact instances up to size $N = 16$, the largest achieving 66% success probability. Separately, a reduced invariant-subspace encoding preserves the dynamics of the deterministic search algorithm on two qubits for nominal problem sizes up to $N = 256$, with the success probability approaching 50%. Resource analyses of logical, hardware-compiled, and fault-tolerant-gate-set-synthesized circuits show that circuit depth and size scale as $\sqrt{N}$, with hardware overheads entering only as constant prefactors. For application-scale graphs ($N \sim 10^5$), an effective gate-fidelity model requires per-gate infidelity near $10^{-7}$. These results establish a concrete algorithm-to-hardware pathway for deterministic structured quantum search on gate-based quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 首次在门型量子处理器上实验实现完全二部图上的确定性离散时间量子行走搜索，全空间编码下 N=4、8 成功率 97.6%、70.8%，N=16 达 66%；约化不变子空间编码在 2 量子比特上模拟至 N=256；电路深度与规模按 √N 标度，应用于 N~10⁵ 需单门错误率约 10⁻⁷。
AI.motivation: 完全二部图为确定性量子搜索提供二次加速的典型平台，但此前缺乏在门型量子处理器上的实验验证；同时需要评估该算法在硬件编译与容错门集下的资源标度，判断其向应用规模扩展的可行性。
AI.method: 采用基于数字门电路的处理器（而非演化型平台），结合高保真操作与动态相位补偿方案；将搜索电路编译到原生门集与方晶格拓扑；实现全空间编码（N=4、8、16）与约化不变子空间编码（2 量子比特承载 N≤256 的名义规模）；并对逻辑、硬件编译及容错门集综合三种层级的电路做资源分析。
AI.result: 全空间编码下 N=4 与 N=8 的标记顶点搜索成功率分别为 97.6% 与 70.8%；资源高效精确实例至 N=16，最大规模成功率 66%。约化不变子空间编码保持确定性搜索动力学，成功率趋近 50%。深度与规模随 √N 标度，硬件开销仅以常数前因子进入；N~10⁵ 时有效门保真度模型要求单门错误率约 10⁻⁷。
AI.conclusion: 建立了确定性结构化量子搜索从算法到硬件的具体通路，验证了门型量子处理器上完全二部图量子行走搜索的可行性，并给出向应用规模扩展所需的门保真度指标。

title: Imperfect Cavities Select Better: Enantioselectivity Beyond Pure Helicity
summary: Single-handed light appears ideally suited to select a preferred handedness of matter. For chiral molecules in a cavity, we show that this intuition fails. Hybridization of light and matter reshapes the optical resonance through a self-energy that mixes opposite helicities. As a result, the difference in power absorbed by opposite enantiomers is generically maximized by light of mixed, rather than pure, helicity. We clarify why chiral selection admits such mixed-helicity optima in more general light--matter systems. For a concrete set of cavity modes, we find that molecular localization at a weak helicity bias considerably outperforms helically pure designs, thus identifying spatial control as a promising design direction for devices previously thought to be ``imperfect''.

AI.tldr: 手性光并非腔内手性分子对映体选择性吸收的最优选择：光-物质杂化使相反螺度发生混合，混合螺度光的吸收差异通常大于纯手性光，空间局域化设计更优。
AI.motivation: "单手握性光最适合选择物质手性"这一直觉广泛存在，但缺乏对腔中手性分子情形的严格检验；作者意在澄清该直觉何时失效及其物理根源。
AI.method: 针对腔中手性分子，基于光-物质杂化的自能（self-energy）分析光学共振的重新塑形，考察自能如何混合相反螺旋度；在具体腔模集合下计算对映体吸收功率差，并比较纯螺旋度光与混合螺旋度光、以及不同分子空间局域化方案的表现。
AI.result: 对映体吸收功率差一般不因纯螺旋度光而最大，而由混合螺旋度光最大化；在给定腔模下，位于弱螺旋度偏置处的分子局域化显著优于螺旋度纯化的设计。
AI.conclusion: 手性选择在更一般的光-物质体系中允许混合螺旋度最优解；空间控制（分子定位）是手性选择器件有前景的设计方向，此前被视为"不完美"的设计可被重新评价。

title: Readout errors limit how far adaptive quantum circuits can entangle
summary: Measurement and feedforward let quantum circuits entangle arbitrarily distant qubits in constant depth if measurement records are perfect and classical communication is instantaneous. We allow each reported bit to flip independently with a fixed probability between zero and one half, keeping all gates ideal. Consider a square-lattice device with a unique path between the endpoints and a bounded number of qubits per site. Beyond $\exp[O(D^3)]$ steps along that path, every depth-$D$ circuit starting from a product state leaves the endpoints exactly separable in every record, however rare. By copying outcomes onto spare qubits beside the path before readout, we attain a reach of $\exp[Θ(D^3)]$ for a nondestructive parity measurement at fixed accuracy without postselection. On a one-dimensional chain, the optimal reach for the same measurement is $\exp[Θ(D^2)]$. On any interaction graph, a constant-depth circuit starting from a product state needs $Ω(L\ln L)$ qubits to entangle endpoints at graph distance $L$. The reliability of local readout thus limits the depth advantage of adaptive circuits for long-range entanglement.

AI.tldr: 允许测量报告以固定概率独立翻转（0<p<1/2）时，深度为D的测量-前馈电路从乘积态出发所能产生的纠缠"可达距离"是有限的：方形格子上界为 exp[O(D^3)]，通过把测量结果复制到备用量子比特可实现 exp[Θ(D^3)] 的最优可达；一维链为 exp[Θ(D^2)]；任意相互作用图上纠缠图距L的两端点需 Ω(L ln L) 个量子比特。
AI.motivation: 经典前馈与测量可使量子电路在常数深度下纠缠任意远距离的量子比特，但这一结论依赖于"测量记录完美"与"经典通信瞬时"两个理想假设。本文旨在考察测量报告存在噪声（比特以固定概率翻转）时，深度优势是否仍然成立，即局部读出可靠性如何限制自适应电路产生长程纠缠的能力。
AI.method: 保持所有量子门理想，仅令每个上报的测量比特以固定概率在(0,1/2)间独立翻转。研究方形晶格器件（端点间唯一路径、每格点量子比特数有界），对沿路径步数超过 exp[O(D^3)] 的情形证明：任意深度D电路从乘积态出发，在每一种记录下两端点都严格可分（对所有记录均如此，无论多罕见）。随后通过将测量结果在读出前复制到路径旁的备用量子比特上，用固定精度的非破坏性宇称测量构造协议，达成 exp[Θ(D^3)] 的可达距离（无需后选择）。此外分析一维链与一般相互作用图。
AI.result: 方形格子：可达距离上界 exp[O(D^3)]，构造达到 exp[Θ(D^3)]（固定精度、无后选择）；一维链同一测量的最优可达为 exp[Θ(D^2)]；任意图上，从乘积态出发的常数深度电路要纠缠图距L的两端点，需 Ω(L ln L) 个量子比特。
AI.conclusion: 局部读出的可靠性根本性地限制了自适应（测量-前馈）电路的长程纠缠能力：深度优势随距离呈指数（而非任意远）增长，且存在与维度相关的确定性标度律及图上的量子比特数下界，"完美记录"假设对常数深度纠缠任意远端点是不可或缺的。

title: A Forward Bit Makes Error Correction Dispensable for Antidegradable Amplitude-Damping Channels
summary: Preserving a qubit usually relies on redundant encoding over many uses of a noisy channel. We prove that for antidegradable amplitude damping, one channel use with one forward classical bit matches or beats every forward-assisted or unassisted code with any number of uses. We then show that variational circuits learn to switch from error correction to classical assistance as damping grows, beating a dual-certified bound on all unassisted three-use codes and, relative to the best unassisted see-saw, extending storage time by up to 13% at entanglement fidelity down to 0.65.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对反退化幅度阻尼信道，证明"单次信道使用+1个前向经典比特"即可匹配或超越任意多次使用的辅助/无辅助编码，并提出变分电路随阻尼增强自动从纠错切换到经典辅助的策略，显著延长存储时间。
AI.motivation: 传统保存量子比特依赖在噪声信道的多次使用上进行冗余编码，但冗余编码在强阻尼等噪声条件下未必最优，需要探明经典前向辅助能否取代冗余编码，并寻找可自适应调整的实用策略。
AI.method: 对反退化幅度阻尼信道建立理论上界与可达性分析，比较"单次使用+1前向经典比特"与任意次数的前向辅助/无辅助编码；同时构造变分量子电路优化存储方案，并借助对偶方法给出三次使用无辅助编码的界，与最佳无辅助see-saw方案对比。
AI.result: 证明单次使用加1个前向经典比特即可匹配或超越任意长度的辅助/无辅助编码；变分电路随阻尼增大自动由纠错转向经典辅助，击败三次使用无辅助编码的对偶认证界；在纠缠保真度低至0.65时，相较最佳无辅助see-saw将存储时间最多延长13%。
AI.conclusion: 在反退化幅度阻尼下，冗余编码并非必要，经典前向辅助可提供资源效率更高的存储方案；变分学习能自发发现纠错与经典辅助之间的最优切换，为噪声量子存储提供可认证且实用的设计原则。

title: Generative Models using Multi-layer Quantum Extreme Learning Machines
summary: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) and the closely related quantum extreme learning machine (QELM) paradigm exploit the complex dynamics of an uncontrolled quantum system for machine learning, offering an alternative to variational quantum algorithms whose training is hindered by barren plateaus and costly circuit optimization. Because the quantum system itself is left fixed, learning reduces to fitting a linear readout of a set of measured observables, and no gradient is ever taken through the quantum device. In this work we repurpose this paradigm for generative modeling: a fixed, randomly initialized multi-layer QELM transforms a scalar latent variable into a rich vector of measured expectation values, and only a simple linear readout is trained to map these to samples of a target distribution. The readout is fitted by minimizing the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between generated and target samples. We show that this algorithm is capable of reproducing a range of one- and two-dimensional distributions. Moreover, encoding the class label on dedicated qubits enables conditional generation of different classes of distributions with the same linear readout. We show that this cannot be achieved by the linear readout alone, and that the reservoir dynamics play a role in the ability to distinguish the different classes of distributions. We also show that using a simple six-qubit reservoir one is able to generate handwritten digits from the Digits and MNIST datasets with high accuracy. Moreover, replacing the Haar-random dynamics by time evolution under several physical Hamiltonians leaves the performance unchanged, provided the evolution spreads the input across the register. Finally, we show that a classical random Fourier feature model of the same size performs equally well: at the sizes we study, the QELM offers no advantage over its classical counterpart.

AI.tldr: 将固定随机量子极端学习机(QELM)作为生成模型：标量潜变量经固定多层量子储池映射为可观测量期望值向量，仅训练线性读出以匹配目标分布(MMD损失)，可实现一/二维分布与条件生成及MNIST手写数字生成；但同规模经典随机傅里叶特征模型表现相当，未见量子优势。
AI.motivation: 量子储池计算(QRC)与量子极端学习机(QELM)因量子系统保持固定、只训练经典线性读出，规避了变分量子算法的贫瘠高原与高昂电路优化成本。作者希望把这一范式从判别/回归任务拓展到生成建模，考察其可行性与潜在优势。
AI.method: 以固定、随机初始化的多层QELM作为特征映射：标量潜变量输入量子储池，测量一组可观测量的期望值得到高维特征向量；仅训练线性读出将其映射为样本，通过最小化生成样本与目标样本间的最大均值差异(MMD)拟合读出，全程不对量子器件求梯度。类别标签编码于专用量子比特以实现同一读出下的条件生成；并将Haar随机动力学替换为若干物理哈密顿量下的时间演化进行对比，另设同规模经典随机傅里叶特征(RFF)基线。
AI.result: 该算法可复现多类一维与二维分布；标签编码后可条件生成不同类别分布，且消融表明仅靠线性读出无法实现，储池动力学对类别区分有实质贡献；六量子比特储池即可高精度生成Digits与MNIST手写数字；用物理哈密顿量演化替代Haar随机动力学后性能基本不变，条件是演化能将输入有效散布至整个寄存器；同规模经典RFF模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 固定量子储池+线性读出的生成框架在分布建模与条件生成上可行且对动力学来源较稳健，但在所研究规模下QELM相对经典随机特征模型无优势，量子储池的生成优势仍有待在大规模或特定资源条件下验证。

title: Quantum-Enhanced Passive and Active Radio-Frequency Photonic Imaging
summary: Radio-frequency (RF) photonics enables broadband, phase-coherent sensing beyond the reach of purely electronic architectures, yet at a given optical carrier power its sensitivity is bounded by the standard quantum limit of the optical readout. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that this limit can be surpassed in both passive and active RF imaging modalities by encoding RF signals onto a bright phase-squeezed optical carrier and recovering them via balanced homodyne detection, while the RF front end, illumination, and image reconstruction remain classical. A unified measurement model shows that phase squeezing reduces the variance of the additive readout noise by a single factor $g$, yielding peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) gains of up to $2G$, where $G\equiv10\log_{10}(1/g)$: between $G$ and $2G$ for deterministic targets in active imaging when the classical noise of the echoes is negligible against the readout noise, and set by the ratio of scene noise to readout noise in passive imaging. We validate the model in an experiment in the 5--20 MHz band, in which synthesized RF scenes are replayed through a physical squeezed-light receiver. With 3 dB of squeezing, the PSNR improves by about 6 dB, close to $2G$, in the readout-noise-dominated regime of both modalities, and the model predicts the measured gains without free parameters. These results identify where squeezed-light readout benefits RF-photonic imaging: wherever the optical readout noise, rather than the scene or the RF front end, dominates the image error.

AI.tldr: 将RF信号编码到明亮相位压缩光载波上，用平衡零拍探测读出，可在被动与主动RF成像中突破光学读出的标准量子极限，PSNR增益在3 dB压缩下约6 dB。
AI.motivation: RF光子学可实现宽带、相位相干的传感，但在给定光载波功率下，其灵敏度受光学读出的标准量子极限限制。作者希望用压缩光突破该极限，并厘清增益在何种条件下成立。
AI.method: 把RF信号编码到明亮相位压缩光载波上，通过平衡零拍探测恢复信号，RF前端、照明与图像重建仍保持经典。建立统一测量模型，指出相位压缩以单一因子g降低附加读出噪声方差；在5–20 MHz频段将合成RF场景回放通过实际压缩光接收机进行实验验证。
AI.result: 峰值信噪比（PSNR）增益最高可达2G，其中G≡10log10(1/g)；主动成像中确定性目标在回波经典噪声远小于读出噪声时增益处于G与2G之间，被动成像中则由场景噪声与读出噪声之比决定。实验中3 dB压缩使PSNR提升约6 dB，接近2G，且模型无自由参数即可预测实测增益。
AI.conclusion: 压缩光读出的效益定位明确：当图像误差由光学读出噪声而非场景噪声或RF前端主导时，压缩光读出能显著提升RF光子成像灵敏度。

title: feedback-grape: A JAX-based Python Package for GPU-Accelerated GRAPE with Feedback
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to SciPost Physics Codebases. Code available at https://github.com/YousefElbrolosy/feedbackGRAPE
summary: Modern quantum technology applications require accurate control of quantum systems, including a feedback loop in the control process. While open-loop control can be performed using well established gradient methods like GRadient Ascent Pulse Engineering (GRAPE), it was until recently unclear how to combine these with feedback from measurements, which are inherently non-differentiable. Recent work has successfully demonstrated how feedback can be incorporated into GRAPE using machine learning, resolving this issue. Following this progress, we have developed an efficient Python package implementing the method of ``feedback GRAPE''. In this hands-on tutorial, we discuss the package in detail based on concrete examples. Built on the GPU-accelerated JAX platform, our package offers a user-friendly interface inspired by the widely-used QuTiP library, including simplified treatment of multi-component systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍一个基于JAX GPU加速的Python软件包，实现"feedback GRAPE"方法，用于含测量反馈的量子最优控制，并以具体实例进行教程式讲解。
AI.motivation: 量子技术应用需要带反馈回路的精确量子控制。开环控制可用GRAPE等梯度方法，但测量反馈本质不可微，难以与梯度优化结合；近期借助机器学习将反馈纳入GRAPE取得突破，尚缺乏易用的实现工具。
AI.method: 在GPU加速的JAX平台上实现feedback GRAPE，提供仿QuTiP风格的友好接口，并简化多组分系统的处理；通过具体示例进行hands-on教程式讲解。
AI.result: 给出一个高效Python包，具备JAX加速、QuTiP式接口与多组分系统简化处理能力，并在实例中演示其用法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将反馈GRAPE方法工程化为可用的开源工具，降低量子反馈控制优化方法的使用门槛。

title: Pre-amplification for Preserving Quantum Resources Through an Open-Air, Room-Temperature Microwave Channel
summary: We model a scenario where the pre-amplified signal mode of a two-mode squeezed vacuum (TMSV) state generated by a Josephson parametric converter (JPC) is transmitted through a room-temperature, open-air channel, while the idler is retained at low temperature. Before transmission, the state contains three quantum resources: (1) entanglement, (2) non-classicality, and (3) sub-vacuum conditional prediction of the signal quadrature. To preserve these resources through noise and loss, we consider two forms of quantum-limited pre-amplification of the signal mode: phase-preserving amplification (PPA) and phase-sensitive amplification (PSA). We identify three thresholds for a fixed amount of loss as noise increases from zero marking the loss of (1) entanglement, (2) non-classicality, and (3) sub-vacuum conditional prediction of the signal quadrature, respectively. We find first that entanglement is fatally sensitive to the noise and loss in our channel model and neither form of pre-amplification protects it. On the other hand, phase-sensitive pre-amplification is shown to significantly raise the thresholds at which non-classicality and sub-vacuum conditional prediction are destroyed. For a 3-meter link between room-temperature horn antennas at 5 GHz, the noise thresholds for these resources can be orders of magnitude above the thermal background. Further analysis shows that these conclusions are robust to limited phase misalignment and pre-amplifier-added noise, with the latter having the stronger effect. These surviving non-classical resources may support quantum-enhanced sensing, illumination, and metrology protocols even in regimes where entanglement itself is destroyed. Our results suggest that protocols that exploit these quantum phenomena are the most likely to succeed in microwave applications.

AI.tldr: 该文研究JPC产生的双模压缩真空态在室温开放空气信道传输时，相位敏感预放大能保留非经典性与亚真空条件预测，但纠缠在噪声与损耗下必然失效。
AI.motivation: 微波量子资源在室温开放空气链路中易受噪声与损耗破坏，需明确不同量子资源（纠缠、非经典性、亚真空条件预测）的存活边界，并评估预放大方案的保护能力。
AI.method: 以JPC生成TMSV态，信号模经室温开放空气信道传输、闲置模低温保留；对信号模分别采用相位保持放大（PPA）与相位敏感放大（PSA），在固定损耗下扫描噪声，确定三类资源失效的噪声阈值，并分析相位失配与预放大器附加噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 纠缠对噪声与损耗极度敏感，两种预放大均无法保护；PSA显著提升非经典性与亚真空条件预测的破坏阈值。5 GHz、3米室温喇叭天线链路下，这些阈值可高出热背景数个量级；结论对有限相位失配稳健，预放大器附加噪声影响更强。
AI.conclusion: 在纠缠已被破坏的区间内，存活的非经典资源仍可支撑量子增强传感、照明与计量协议，此类协议最有可能在微波应用中实现。

title: Graph spectra and late-time concurrence in a lossy reservoir network
summary: We investigate how coupling the local environments of noninteracting qubits into a network changes their late-time entanglement dynamics. Each qubit interacts with a lossy bosonic memory mode, with coherent hopping between memory modes determined by an underlying graph. The initial state contains at most two excitations. We show that the graph spectrum selects the collective modes that survive longest, thereby controlling both the decay and spatial distribution of pair concurrence. At resonance, nonbipartite graphs generically approach a fixed pattern of relative concurrence determined by the Perron eigenvector, whereas bipartite graphs support interference between two equally damped modes. This interference can produce arbitrarily late entanglement revivals when it overcomes the exponential decay of the surviving modes. We derive explicit thresholds separating revival and eventual monotonic decay, and show that loss from two-excitation states can drive the system across these thresholds without changing the graph or the initial one-excitation state. Underlying these results is a general bound on the sector decay rates, $γ_2\ge2γ_1$, valid at arbitrary uniform detuning. We also identify an exceptional equal-rate regime in which coherence between the vacuum and two-excitation sectors contributes to the leading concurrence. Together, these results establish how the topology of a structured dissipative environment and the redistribution of excitations through loss determine the long-time behavior of entanglement.

AI.tldr: 研究将非相互作用量子比特的局域环境耦合为网络（图结构）如何改变其晚期纠缠动力学：图谱选择最长寿命的集体模式，控制并发度的衰减与空间分布；非二部图趋向Perron本征矢决定的固定相对并发度，二部图则支持两等阻尼模式干涉并产生任意晚的纠缠复现，给出复现与单调衰减的显式阈值及γ₂≥2γ₁的衰减率界。
AI.motivation: 以往对开放量子系统纠缠动力学的研究多关注单个或独立环境，缺乏对"结构化耗散环境"拓扑（图结构图谱）如何决定纠缠长时间行为（衰减、空间分布、复现）的系统理解。
AI.method: 构建模型：每个非相互作用量子比特与一个有耗散玻色记忆模式耦合，记忆模式间按给定图进行相干跳跃；初态最多含两个激发。通过分析图谱与集体模式（含Perron本征矢、二部图的等阻尼模式对）解析推导双激发与单激发扇区的衰减率关系（γ₂≥2γ₁，任意均匀失谐下成立），并给出复现—单调衰减的阈值判据。
AI.result: 1）图谱决定存活最久的集体模式，从而控制成对并发度的衰减与空间分布；2）共振时非二部图趋于由Perron本征矢确定的固定相对并发度模式，二部图则出现两个等阻尼模式的干涉，干涉超过存活模式的指数衰减时可产生任意晚的纠缠复现；3）导出区分"复现"与"最终单调衰减"的显式阈值，并表明双激发态的损耗可在不改变图与单激发初态的情况下驱动系统跨越阈值；4）给出扇区衰减率一般界γ₂≥2γ₁（任意均匀失谐）；5）识别出真空与双激发扇区相干性对领头阶并发度有贡献的"等速率"例外区制。
AI.conclusion: 结构化耗散环境的拓扑（图谱）与由损耗引起的激发重分布在很大程度上共同决定纠缠的长时间行为；纠缠复现可由图对称性（二部性）与模式干涉而非单纯衰减控制。

title: Generalized Rotating-Wave Approximations Hierarchy for the Interacting Two-Qubit Rabi Model
summary: We investigate the two-qubit quantum Rabi model for identical qubits symmetrically coupled to a single bosonic mode and interacting with each other through transverse and longitudinal couplings. We extend the adiabatic, generalized rotating-wave (GRWA), and squeezed generalized rotating-wave (SGRWA) approximations to include the qubit-qubit interactions, including self-consistent and variational choices of the bosonic parameters. The resulting analytical hierarchy allows us to distinguish the interplay between both kinds of qubit-qubit interactions and the effects of displacement, neighboring-manifold mixing, and squeezing on the low-energy properties. We find that the transverse interaction mainly changes the collective-spin structure of the states, while the longitudinal interaction also modifies the displacement-dependent oscillator overlaps and introduces an additional two-boson coupling. We compare the analytical results with numerically exact diagonalization for the low-energy spectrum, ground-state energy, mean photon number, two-qubit concurrence, and spin correlations. The results provide a compact analytical description of how direct qubit-qubit interactions modify both the spectrum and the eigenstate structure beyond the rotating-wave approximation for few-qubit light-matter systems.

AI.tldr: 研究两个相同量子比特对称耦合到单玻色模并含横/纵比特间耦合的双比特量子Rabi模型，将绝热、广义旋波(GRWA)与压缩广义旋波(SGRWA)近似推广至包含比特间相互作用（含玻色参数的自洽与变分选择），并系统比较解析与数值精确对角化结果。
AI.motivation: 少比特光-物质系统中，超越旋波近似的描述通常忽略比特间直接相互作用；作者希望建立一个能同时刻画光-物质耦合与比特-比特横/纵耦合的紧凑解析框架，以厘清两类比特间相互作用对低能谱和本征态结构的不同影响。
AI.method: 对双比特量子Rabi模型引入横场与纵场比特间耦合，将绝热近似、广义旋波近似(GRWA)和压缩广义旋波近似(SGRWA)推广以纳入这些相互作用；玻色（位移/压缩）参数分别采用自洽确定与变分确定两种方案，构建分层解析近似体系，用以分离位移、相邻流形混合与压缩效应对低能性质的贡献；并与数值精确对角化对照，考察低能谱、基态能量、平均光子数、双比特共度(concurrence)与自旋关联。
AI.result: 横向比特间耦合主要改变态的集体自旋结构；纵向耦合除改变集体自旋结构外，还修正依赖位移的振子重叠积分，并引入额外的双玻色子耦合项。解析结果在低能谱、基态能量、平均光子数、concurrence和自旋关联上与数值精确对角化一致。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的含比特间相互作用的GRWA/SGRWA解析层级，给出了超越旋波近似下直接比特-比特相互作用如何同时修饰能谱与本征态结构的紧凑解析描述，适用于少比特光-物质系统。

title: Response-Threshold Framework for First-Peak Preservation in Noisy Grover Search
summary: Grover search is executed only after integer iterations, so noise can alter the stopping decision even when a continuous first peak remains visible. We develop a response-threshold framework separating continuous peak motion, stroboscopic geometry, and the discrete sampled-success argmax. For a Drude-Lorentz environment, linearized HEOM supplies an a priori timing coefficient and sampled-probability differentials. The first-order layer is used as a conservative screen: well-separated points retain the nominal step, whereas near-threshold points escalate to finite-$λ$ evaluation. Across 260 unique HEOM points drawn from five overlapping validation sets, it detects all 15 observed stopping changes with zero regret on the changed subset; its residual errors are 45 one-step-early calls on otherwise stable points; the 245-point stable subset has mean regret $4.42\times10^{-3}$. An empirically validated two-stage workflow escalates every observed change while avoiding 160 of 260 unique full-HEOM propagations. Same-bath NZ2 reduces early calls. A heterogeneous three-qubit circuit exhibits three stopping-transition scales, each replicated across eight marked targets, and finite-shot recovery is 96.18% overall, with failures localized to a near-degenerate boundary at $s=1.5$. A depth-refined transfer test supports the predicted local quadratic timing-to-loss relation.

AI.tldr: 提出"响应阈值"框架，分离连续峰值运动、频闪几何与离散采样argmax，用线性化HEOM的时序系数做保守筛查，仅对近阈值点升级到有限-λ计算，从而在避免大量全HEOM传播的同时捕捉所有停止决策变化。
AI.motivation: Grover搜索只能在整数次迭代后停止，噪声会改变停止决策，即使连续意义下首个峰值依然可见；因此需要一个能对停止决策变化做先验判定的框架。
AI.method: 构建响应阈值框架，分层为连续峰值运动、频闪几何（stroboscopic geometry）与离散采样成功概率argmax；对Drude-Lorentz环境用线性化HEOM给出先验时序系数与采样概率微分；一阶层作为保守筛查，远离阈值的点保留名义步长，近阈值点升级为有限-λ评估；另设两阶段工作流、同浴NZ2修正及异构三比特电路检验（有限采样恢复、深度细化转移测试）。
AI.result: 在5个重叠验证集共260个唯一HEOM点中，检出全部15次停止变化，变化子集遗憾为零；残余误差为45个稳定点被提前一步判停；245点稳定子集平均遗憾4.42×10^-3。两阶段流程升级所有观测变化，同时避免160/260次全HEOM传播。同浴NZ2减少提前判停。异构三比特电路呈三个停止转变尺度，各在8个标记目标上复现，有限采样恢复率整体96.18%，失败集中于s=1.5附近的近简并边界。深度细化转移测试支持所预测的局部二次时序-损失关系。
AI.conclusion: 一阶响应阈值筛查可在零漏检的条件下显著降低全HEOM计算开销，两阶段流程兼顾准确性与效率；同浴修正与转变尺度分析刻画了有限采样下的失效边界，并验证了时序-损失的局部二次律。

title: Formally verified harness for Shor's order finding algorithm with $O(n^{2+ε})$ gate cost
comment: 33 pages (13 pages of main text and the rest are appendices), 8 figures. Project website: https://forshor.ai , Lean formalization: https://verifiedqc.github.io/ForShor/
summary: It is commonly understood that factoring a general $n$-bit biprime via Shor's order finding algorithm requires $\widetilde{O}(n^3)$ gates by leveraging schoolbook integer arithmetics for addition and multiplication. Recent developments in quantum arithmetic circuits leveraging recursive Toom-Cook schemes have improved the cost scaling to $O(n^{2+ε})$. Here $ε>0$ depends on algorithm implementation details of the recursive multiplication steps, which allow for a vast number of design choices. The challenge in navigating such design space also presents an opportunity for demonstrating innovative practices in quantum software engineering in the era of open agentic science. We present a formally verified harness that ingests a design specification (namely a "policy" that describes a recursive circuit design scheme) from an external source, which may be an AI agent, and produces a set of formalized proofs covering mathematical correctness of the algorithm implementation, asymptotic scaling of the end-to-end gate cost, as well as the correctness of translating the verified algorithm to a detailed circuit implementation with an intermediate representation. The harness is published as an open challenge where human researchers and AI agents can search for more efficient factoring circuits while retaining machine-checked guarantees of correctness and end-to-end asymptotic complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出一个形式化验证框架（harness），可接收外部（含AI代理）给出的递归Toom-Cook乘法电路设计"策略"，自动产出覆盖算法数学正确性、端到端门代价渐近标度、以及经中间表示到详细电路实现之翻译正确性的机器可检验证明，并以开放挑战形式征集更高效因式分解电路。
AI.motivation: Shor阶查找算法用教科书式整数运算需约 Õ(n³) 门；递归Toom-Cook方案已把代价降到 O(n^{2+ε})，但 ε 依赖递归乘法步骤的实现细节，设计空间巨大、选项繁多。既要驾驭该设计空间，又要在"开放代理式科学"时代示范量子软件工程的创新实践，因此需要一个能对接纳外部设计的正确性与复杂度保证自动形式化的机制。
AI.method: 构建形式化验证harness：以"policy"（描述递归电路设计方案的规范）为输入，从外部来源（可为AI代理）导入；随后生成一组形式化证明，分别针对（1）算法实现的数学正确性，（2）端到端门代价的渐近标度，（3）将已验证算法经由中间表示翻译为详细电路实现的正确性。该harness作为公开挑战发布，供人类研究者与AI代理搜索更高效电路。
AI.result: 给出可机检的正确性与端到端渐近复杂度保证，使设计者可在保留形式化保证的前提下探索 O(n^{2+ε}) 乃至更优的因式分解电路设计；harness 以开放挑战形式公开。
AI.conclusion: 将大规模电路设计空间的搜索与机器检验的正确性/复杂度证明解耦，为开放式（含AI代理参与）量子软件工程提供了可复用的验证范式。

title: Lower bounds for testing the completely depolarizing channel
summary: We study lower bounds to the query complexity of testing whether an unknown quantum channel mapping a $d_{\mathrm{in}}$-dimensional input to a $d_{\mathrm{out}}$-dimensional output is the completely depolarizing channel or is $\varepsilon$-far from it in diamond distance. We show that for this task (i) any ancilla-assisted, coherent, adaptive tester requires at least $Ω(d_{\mathrm{in}}d_{\mathrm{out}}/\varepsilon^2)$ queries; (ii) any ancilla-assisted, coherent, non-adaptive tester requires at least $\max\{Ω(d_{\mathrm{in}}^{1.5}d_{\mathrm{out}}/\varepsilon^2), Ω(d_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}/\varepsilon^2)\}$ queries. We also show that these lower bounds apply to the more general problem of determining whether an unknown channel belongs to the set of all state-replacement channels or is $\varepsilon$-far from the entire set in diamond distance.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了测试未知量子信道是否为完全退极化信道（或与之 ε-远离）的下界：任何辅助比特辅助、相干、自适应测试器至少需 Ω(d_in d_out/ε²) 次查询；非自适应测试器至少需 max{Ω(d_in^1.5 d_out/ε²), Ω(d_in²/ε²)} 次查询；这些下界同样适用于判断信道是否属于全体态替换信道集合的推广问题。
AI.motivation: 研究量子信道性质测试（channel property testing）的查询复杂度下界，具体针对"完全退极化信道"这一性质，以刻画自适应与非自适应、相干测试策略所需查询数的本质差距。
AI.method: 采用查询复杂度下界证明技术（信息论/对抗性论证），在钻石距离度量下分别针对 (i) 带辅助比特的相干自适应测试器 与 (ii) 带辅助比特的相干非自适应测试器 建立下界；并将结果推广至态替换信道集合的成员性测试。
AI.result: 自适应相干测试器下界为 Ω(d_in d_out/ε²)；非自适应相干测试器下界为 max{Ω(d_in^1.5 d_out/ε²), Ω(d_in²/ε²)}。这些下界亦适用于判断信道是否属于全体态替换信道集合（或与之 ε-远离）的问题。
AI.conclusion: 非自适应测试在维度依赖上明显劣于自适应测试（d_in^1.5 或 d_in² 对比 d_in），揭示了相干自适应性的查询优势；且对更一般的态替换信道集合测试问题同样成立。

title: Phase-conjugate Gaussian encoding for continuous-variable quantum key distribution with a single phase-sensitive amplifier
summary: Phase-conjugate encoding is naturally compatible with shared phase-sensitive amplification and joint detection, offering a compact optical receiver architecture for continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CVQKD). Here, we develop a unified encoding and security framework for two-mode Gaussian CVQKD with tunable phase-conjugate intermode correlations matched to a joint receiver comprising a single phase-sensitive amplifier (PSA) and one balanced photodetector. We present both coherent-state and squeezed-state prepare-and-measure protocols that use the same transmitted ensemble. The two preparations can be implemented through classically precoded Gaussian displacements of coherent sidebands or a directly generated two-mode squeezed vacuum, respectively, without an actual optical mode converter. The encoding and detection scheme separates low-variance joint quadratures for key generation from high-variance joint quadratures carrying private random modulation. This complementary modulation can reduce Eve's Holevo information without changing the Alice--Bob mutual information. Numerical results show that optimized correlated coherent-state encoding achieves higher asymptotic key rates at long distances and extends the positive-key range compared with optimized single-mode coherent-state modulation. The optimal intermode correlation increases with transmission distance, and the range advantage persists under the symmetric correlated two-mode Gaussian attacks considered here. These results provide a theoretical basis for the design and implementation of PSA-enhanced two-mode CVQKD with phase-conjugate encoding.

AI.tldr: 该文为二分高斯CVQKD建立统一的相位共轭编码与安全性框架，接收端仅用单个PSA与一个平衡探测器，并对比压缩态与相干态两种制备方案。
AI.motivation: 相位共轭编码天然适配共享的相位敏感放大与联合探测，可实现紧凑的CVQKD光接收机；需系统刻画其编码与安全性，并明确无需实际模式转换器的可行制备方式。
AI.method: 构建与可调相位共轭模间关联匹配的联合接收架构（单PSA+单平衡探测器）；给出相干态与压缩态两类prepare-and-measure协议共用同一发送系综，分别由相干边带的经典预编码高斯位移或直接产生的双模压缩真空实现；采用互补调制——低方差联合正交分量用于成钥、高方差联合正交分量承载私有随机调制；在对称相关双模高斯攻击下数值评估渐近密钥率。
AI.result: 互补调制可在不改变Alice–Bob互信息的前提下降低Eve的Holevo信息；优化后的相关相干态编码在长距离下渐近密钥率更高，且扩展了正密钥传输范围（优于优化的单模相干态调制）；最优模间关联随传输距离增大，该距离优势在对称相关双模高斯攻击下依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 结果为相位共轭编码的PSA增强型双模CVQKD设计与实现提供理论基础。

title: Collective coupling of over 100 individually trapped atoms to a single cavity mode
summary: Coupling optical tweezer arrays to high-finesse cavities provides a shared optical interface for neutral-atom registers. Scaling this interface to large tweezer arrays requires placing many traps within the coupling region of a single cavity mode while maintaining uniform trapping and site-resolved detection. Here we match a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to the coupling profile of a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity. To improve trap uniformity in the array generated by crossed acousto-optic deflectors, we combine optimization with optical feedback and atomic fluorescence feedback, achieving a mean cesium loading probability of approximately 58%. In each trial, fluorescence imaging determines whether each individual tweezer site is occupied, allowing the cavity transmission spectra to be grouped by atom number. The grouped spectra exhibit resolved normal-mode doublets, and the group with 120 imaged atoms yields an effective collective coupling of $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2π) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz. A model based on the calculated coupling profile and measured site loading probabilities predicts that the mean squared coupling per occupied site changes little between 97 and 120 atoms. The fitted collective coupling is therefore consistent with square-root scaling with atom number despite the spatial variation in single-atom coupling. These results provide an experimental basis for studying photon-mediated many-body dynamics and developing cavity-assisted readout and optical links between neutral-atom registers.

AI.tldr: 将192个光镊构成的二维阵列与毫米级法布里-珀罗腔耦合区匹配，借助优化+光反馈+原子荧光反馈提升阱间均匀性（平均铯装载率约58%），并用逐点荧光成像按原子数分组腔透射谱，观测到分辨的简正模双峰，N=120时集体耦合G_eff/2π=21.30±0.23 MHz，与√N标度一致。
AI.motivation: 光镊阵列与高精细度腔耦合可为中性原子寄存器提供共享光学接口，但要扩展到大规模阵列，必须在单一腔模耦合区内放置大量阱，同时保持阱间均匀性与位点分辨探测能力。
AI.method: 把192个光镊的二维阵列与毫米尺度Fabry-Pérot腔的耦合剖面匹配；针对交叉声光偏转器产生的阵列，结合数值优化、光反馈与原子荧光反馈提升阱均匀性；每次实验用荧光成像判定各阱位点是否被占据，据此按原子数对腔透射谱分组；并建立基于计算耦合剖面与实测位点装载概率的模型，评估每占据位点平均耦合平方随原子数的变化。
AI.result: 平均铯装载概率约58%；分组后的透射谱呈现可分辨的简正模双峰；含120个成像原子的组给出有效集体耦合G_eff/(2π)=21.30±0.23 MHz；模型显示97至120个原子区间内每占据位点耦合平方均值变化很小，故拟合的集体耦合与√N标度一致，尽管单原子耦合存在空间不均。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究光子介导的多体动力学、发展腔辅助读出以及中性原子寄存器间的光学链路提供了实验基础。

title: Rate-1/2 Quantum LDPC Codes for Multi-tier Superconducting Hardware
summary: Quantum error correction is essential for scalable quantum computing, while its resource overhead is governed in large part by the encoding rate, namely the number of logical qubits encoded per physical data qubit. Recent quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) constructions have entered the ultra-high-rate regime with encoding rates above 1/2, but their syndrome-extraction circuits generally rely on reconfigurable connectivity or long-range qubit transport, making them difficult to implement on fixed-connectivity superconducting hardware. Here we introduce Armillary codes, a family of ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes whose algebraic structure is generated by native iSWAP routing under hardware constraints. The construction jointly enforces stabilizer commutation and correct parallel syndrome extraction, while admitting radial and circumferential couplings in crossing-free routing layers. We construct explicit codes with rates above 1/2, stabilizer weight 12, Tanner-graph girth 6, and distances from 12 to 16, with layouts on 5 or 6 hardware tiers. Compared with the Gross and Mitten codes at the same distances, the Armillary codes achieve encoding rates about 6 and 2.5 times those of the Gross and Mitten codes, respectively, while maintaining lower hardware-complexity scores. In circuit-level simulations, the \([\![8688,4348,16]\!]\) code approaches the teraquop regime, achieving a logical error rate of \(1.62\times10^{-12}\) per logical qubit per round at a physical error rate of 0.1\%. These results show that the rate-\(1/2\) regime of qLDPC codes can be extended from reconfigurable platforms to superconducting hardware, providing a route toward low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 提出 Armillary 码：由 iSWAP 路由生成、适配固定连通超导硬件的超高码率 qLDPC 码族，码率>1/2，距离12–16，[8688,4348,16] 码在0.1%物理错误率下逻辑错误率达1.62×10⁻¹²。
AI.motivation: 量子纠错的资源开销主要由编码率决定，但已有超高码率（>1/2）qLDPC 构造依赖可重构连通或长程量子比特传输，难以在固定连通的超导硬件上实现，因此需要在硬件约束下构造高码率码。
AI.method: 提出 Armillary 码族，其代数结构由硬件约束下的原生 iSWAP 路由生成；构造中同时满足稳定子对易性与正确的并行校验提取，采用径向与周向耦合的无交叉路由层布局，显式构造码率>1/2、稳定子权重12、Tanner图围长6、距离12–16、5或6个硬件层的码。
AI.result: 同距离下编码率约为 Gross 码的6倍、Mitten 码的2.5倍，且硬件复杂度评分更低；电路级模拟中 [[8688,4348,16]] 码在0.1%物理错误率下每逻辑量子比特每轮逻辑错误率为1.62×10⁻¹²，接近 teraquop 量级。
AI.conclusion: qLDPC 的高码率区间可从可重构平台推广到固定连通超导硬件，为低开销容错量子处理器提供可行路径。

title: Quantum Sensing of Defects
summary: Metrology of defects (or impurities) is a major challenge in quantum sensing, with implications for material science, nano-scale metrology, and the development of high-precision quantum devices. In this work, we employ single and multi excitation sensors for the metrology of defects, with the system Hamiltonian encoding the structure of the sensor and the defect treated as a perturbation potential. We evaluate the quantum Fisher information of the ground state of the system to quantify the metrological performance of the sensors in locating a defect and in estimating its coupling strength. In doing so, we identify two distinct sensing regimes, determined by the ratio between the defect screening parameter and the inter-sensor site spacing, and establish the scaling behavior for the resulting estimation precision. Furthermore, we analyze the joint estimation of defect position and strength as well as the performance of two-excitation sensors, demonstrating how the number of excitations and their interactions influence sensitivity. Our results provide tools for optimizing defect detection with quantum sensors, with potential applications in solid-state quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文用量子Fisher信息量化单/多激发传感器定位缺陷及估计其耦合强度的精度，识别出两种由缺陷屏蔽参数与格点间距之比决定的传感区制，并给出精度标度律，进而分析位置-强度的联合估计与双激发传感器的性能。
AI.motivation: 缺陷与杂质的计量是量子传感中的重大挑战，关系到材料科学、纳米尺度计量与高精度量子器件研发，需要工具来优化量子传感器对缺陷的探测。
AI.method: 将传感器记为系统哈密顿量、缺陷作为微扰势，采用单激发与多激发传感器模型；以基态量子Fisher信息量化定位缺陷与估计耦合强度的计量性能，并按缺陷屏蔽参数与传感器位点间距之比区分传感区制、推导精度标度，同时研究缺陷位置与强度的联合估计及双激发传感器中激发数与相互作用对灵敏度的影响。
AI.result: 识别出两种不同的传感区制（由屏蔽参数与格点间距之比决定），并建立相应估计精度的标度行为；揭示激发数目及激发间相互作用对灵敏度的影响规律。
AI.conclusion: 结果为利用量子传感器优化缺陷检测提供了工具，可应用于固态量子技术等领域。

title: Quantum Sensor of Mechanical Vibrations
summary: We report the use of a single trapped-ion motional mode as a probe of mechanical vibrations of the Paul trap structure. By exciting vibrations of the trap using an ultrasonic transducer mounted outside the vacuum chamber and probing the ion motion through motional sideband interactions, we observe a clear resonance response of the axial mode. We further demonstrate detection of trap vibrations with amplitudes as low as 0.6 picometers. These measurements show direct coupling between macroscopic mechanical motion and trapped-ion dynamics, providing a route toward vibration sensing using quantum control of motional states.

AI.tldr: 利用单个囚禁离子轴向运动模式作为探针，探测Paul阱结构的机械振动，可实现0.6 pm量级振幅的振动检测。
AI.motivation: 离子阱中的离子对电极结构上的电场涨落极为敏感，因此囚禁离子可反向用作机械振动的灵敏探针；本文旨在验证宏观机械运动与离子运动动力学之间的直接耦合，并探索基于量子控制的振动传感途径。
AI.method: 在真空腔外安装超声换能器激励阱结构振动，通过运动边带相互作用（motional sideband interactions）读取离子运动，测量轴向模式的共振响应。
AI.result: 观察到轴向模式清晰的共振响应，并实现低至0.6 pm振幅的阱振动检测。
AI.conclusion: 宏观机械运动与囚禁离子动力学之间存在直接耦合，为利用运动态的量子控制实现振动传感提供了可行路径。

title: Noise-Aware Testing of NISQ Quantum Programs: Self-Baseline Oracle with a Controlled False-Positive Rate
summary: Testing quantum programs on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices faces a test-oracle problem: hardware noise and finite-shot sampling make the runs of a correct program vary as much as those of a faulty one, so oracles with a fixed acceptance threshold produce false positives that depend on the program and the backend. We present a noise-aware testing framework built on self-baseline calibration: each run of the program under test is compared with repeated executions of a trusted reference program on the same backend, and the acceptance threshold is the $(1-α)$ quantile of the finite-shot null distribution of the Jensen-Shannon divergence, so the oracle's false-positive rate is a level set in advance. A noncentral chi-square model predicts detection power, a homogeneity test and a two-run sentinel detect drift, a mutation engine labels every mutant exactly within a three-class noise-aware taxonomy, and zero-noise extrapolation attributes rejections to faults or noise. In simulation on nine core benchmarks, 32 QASMBench programs, ten real bugs, seven noise regimes and three device snapshots, the oracle's false-positive rate is 0.0011 at $α= 10^{-3}$ over 9,000 correct runs, against 36-74% for fixed thresholds, 8.9% for a QOIN-style filter and 10.8% for a globally calibrated threshold, while attaining the highest F1 on non-equivalent faults (0.941). On an IBM Heron device, using about 14 minutes of QPU time, it rejected none of 82 correct runs and detected 120 of 121 faults and semantic mutants, and a two-run sentinel reduced drift-induced false positives from 27.4% to 1.8%.

AI.tldr: 提出基于"自基线校准"的噪声感知量子程序测试框架，以受信参考程序在同一后端重复执行的有限采样零分布分位数作为接受阈值，使误报率成为预设水平；在仿真与IBM Heron真机上均取得极低误报率与高检出率。
AI.motivation: NISQ设备上测试量子程序存在测试预言（test-oracle）问题：硬件噪声与有限采样使得正确程序与错误程序的运行结果波动相当，固定阈值的oracle会产生依赖程序与后端的误报（假阳性）。
AI.method: 1）自基线校准：将待测程序每次运行与同一后端上受信参考程序的重复执行进行比较；2）以Jensen-Shannon散度有限采样零分布的(1-α)分位数作为接受阈值，使误报率为预设水平；3）用非中心卡方模型预测检测功效；4）用同质性检验与两次运行哨兵（sentinel）检测漂移；5）变异引擎按三类噪声感知分类法精确标注变异体；6）用零噪声外推（ZNE）将拒绝归因于故障或噪声。
AI.result: 仿真：9个核心基准、32个QASMBench程序、10个真实bug、7种噪声机制、3个设备快照，在9000次正确运行上α=10^-3时误报率0.0011，而固定阈值方法为36%–74%，QOIN式过滤器8.9%，全局校准阈值10.8%；非等价故障上F1最高（0.941）。IBM Heron真机：约14分钟QPU时间，82次正确运行零拒绝，检出121个故障与语义变异体中的120个；两次运行哨兵将漂移导致的误报从27.4%降至1.8%。
AI.conclusion: 自基线校准能在噪声与漂移条件下为量子程序测试提供误报率可控、检测功效高且可在真实硬件上部署的测试预言。

title: Observable Spectral Framework for Noisy Amplitude Amplification: Stopping Stability and Correction
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables; includes 38-page supplementary material (10 figures). Submitted to EPJ Quantum Technology
summary: Stopping rules for noisy amplitude amplification often rely on channel-specific success-probability formulas, limiting their transfer across noise mechanisms. We develop an observable spectral framework for stationary noisy standard amplitude amplification under explicit leading-mode, spectral-separation, and residual-control conditions. Within this class, the first amplification lobe has a damped-oscillatory leading component and a bounded non-leading contribution. We derive how frequency shift, damping, and observable phase offset displace the leading peak, and establish sampled-gap criteria for retaining the ideal integer stopping depth, certifying recalibration, or selecting a robust candidate window.
